267        public static class VarAndMemory {
268                public String name;
269                public MemoryAPI memory;
270        }
271        public static class Token {
272                public String string;
273                public TokenType type;
274                public String varNameWithoutMemoryKeyIfKeyIsValid = null;
275                public String varMemoryKey = null;
276                public Token(String string, TokenType type) {
277                        this.string = string;
278                        this.type = type;
279                        
280                        if (isVariable()) {
281                                int index = string.indexOf(".");
282                                if (index > 0 && index < string.length() - 1) {
283                                        varMemoryKey = string.substring(1, index);
284                                        varNameWithoutMemoryKeyIfKeyIsValid = "$" + string.substring(index + 1);
285                                }
286                        }
287                }
288
289                public VarAndMemory getVarNameAndMemory(Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
290                        String varName = varNameWithoutMemoryKeyIfKeyIsValid;
291                        MemoryAPI memory = memoryMap.get(varMemoryKey);
292                        if (memory == null) {
293                                varName = string;
294                                memory = memoryMap.get(MemKeys.LOCAL);
295                        }
296                        if (memory == null) {
297                                throw new RuleException("No memory found for keys: " + varMemoryKey + ", " + MemKeys.LOCAL);
298                        }
299                        
300                        VarAndMemory result = new VarAndMemory();
301                        result.name = varName;
302                        result.memory = memory;
303                        return result;
304                }
305                
306                public String getStringWithTokenReplacement(String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
307                        String text = getString(memoryMap);
308                        if (text == null) return null;
309                        text = Global.getSector().getRules().performTokenReplacement(ruleId, text, dialog.getInteractionTarget(), memoryMap);
310//                      Map<String, String> tokens = Global.getSector().getRules().getTokenReplacements(ruleId, dialog.getInteractionTarget(), memoryMap);
311//                      for (String token : tokens.keySet()) {
312//                              String value = tokens.get(token);
313//                              text = text.replaceAll("(?s)\\" + token, value);
314//                      }
315//                      text = Misc.replaceTokensFromMemory(text, memoryMap);
316                        return text;
317                }
318                public String getString(Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
319                        String string = null;
320                        if (isVariable()) {
321                                VarAndMemory var = getVarNameAndMemory(memoryMap);
322                                string = var.memory.getString(var.name);
323                        } else {
324                                string = this.string;
325                        }
326                        return string;
327                }
328                
329                public Object getObject(Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
330                        Object o = null;
331                        if (isVariable()) {
332                                VarAndMemory var = getVarNameAndMemory(memoryMap);
333                                o = var.memory.get(var.name);
334                        }
335                        return o;
336                }
337                
338                public boolean getBoolean(Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
339                        String str = getString(memoryMap);
340                        return Boolean.parseBoolean(str);
341                }
342                
343                public boolean isBoolean(Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
344                        String str = getString(memoryMap);
345                        return str.toLowerCase().equals("true") || str.toLowerCase().equals("false");
346                }
347                
348                public boolean isFloat(Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
349                        String str = null;
350                        if (isVariable()) {
351                                VarAndMemory var = getVarNameAndMemory(memoryMap);
352                                str = var.memory.getString(var.name);
353                        } else {
354                                str = string;
355                        }
356                        try {
357                                Float.parseFloat(str);
358                                return true;
359                        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
360                                return false;
361                        }
362                }
363                
364                public float getFloat(Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
365                        float result = 0f;
366                        if (isVariable()) {
367                                VarAndMemory var = getVarNameAndMemory(memoryMap);
368                                result = var.memory.getFloat(var.name);
369                        } else {
370                                result = Float.parseFloat(string);
371                        }
372                        return result;
373                }
374                
375                public int getInt(Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
376                        return (int) Math.round(getFloat(memoryMap));
377                }
378                
379                public Color getColor(Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
380                        Object object = null;
381                        if (isVariable()) {
382                                VarAndMemory var = getVarNameAndMemory(memoryMap);
383                                object = var.memory.get(var.name);
384                        }
385                        if (object instanceof Color) {
386                                return (Color) object;
387                        }
388                                        
389                        String string = getString(memoryMap);
390                        try {
391                                String [] parts = string.split(Pattern.quote(","));
392                                return new Color(Integer.parseInt(parts[0]),
393                                                Integer.parseInt(parts[1]),
394                                                Integer.parseInt(parts[2]),
395                                                Integer.parseInt(parts[3]));
396                        } catch (Exception e) {
397                                if ("bad".equals(string)) {
398                                        string = "textEnemyColor";
399                                } else if ("good".equals(string)) {
400                                        string = "textFriendColor";
401                                } else if ("highlight".equals(string)) {
402                                        string = "buttonShortcut";
403                                } else if ("h".equals(string)) {
404                                        string = "buttonShortcut";
405                                } else if ("story".equals(string)) {
406                                        return Misc.getStoryOptionColor();
407                                } else if ("gray".equals(string)) {
408                                        return Misc.getGrayColor();
409                                } else if ("grey".equals(string)) {
410                                        return Misc.getGrayColor();
411                                } else {
412                                        FactionAPI faction = Global.getSector().getFaction(string);
413                                        if (faction != null) {
414                                                return faction.getBaseUIColor();
415                                        }
416                                }
417                                
418                                return Global.getSettings().getColor(string);
419                        }
420                }
421                
422                public boolean isLiteral() {
423                        return type == TokenType.LITERAL;
424                }
425                public boolean isVariable() {
426                        return type == TokenType.VARIABLE;
427                }
428                public boolean isOperator() {
429                        return type == TokenType.OPERATOR;
430                }
431                @Override
432                public String toString() {
433                        if (isVariable()) {
434                                return string + " (" + type.name() + ", memkey: " + varMemoryKey + ", name: " + varNameWithoutMemoryKeyIfKeyIsValid + ")";
435                        } else {
436                                return string + " (" + type.name() + ")";
437                        }
438                }
439        }

441        public static List<Token> tokenize(String string) {
442                List<Token> result = new ArrayList<Token>();
443                boolean inQuote = false;
444                boolean inOperator = false;
445                
446                StringBuffer currToken = new StringBuffer();
447                for (int i = 0; i < string.length(); i++) {
448                        char curr = string.charAt(i);
449                        char next = 0;
450                        if (i + 1 < string.length()) next = string.charAt(i + 1);
451                        boolean charEscaped = false;
452                        if (curr == '\\') {
453                                i++;
454                                if (i >= string.length()) {
455                                        throw new RuleException("Escape character at end of string in: [" + string + "]");
456                                }
457                                curr = string.charAt(i);
458                                if (i + 1 < string.length()) next = string.charAt(i + 1);
459                                charEscaped = true;
460                        }
461//                      if (charEscaped) {
462//                              System.out.println("dfsdfs");
463//                      }
464                        
465                        if (curr == '"' && !charEscaped) {
466                                inQuote = !inQuote;
467                                if (!inQuote && currToken.length() <= 0) {
468                                        result.add(new Token("", TokenType.LITERAL));
469                                } else if (currToken.length() > 0) {
470                                        String str = currToken.toString();
471                                        if (!inQuote) {
472                                                result.add(new Token(str, TokenType.LITERAL));
473                                        } else {
474                                                if (str.startsWith("$")) {
475                                                        result.add(new Token(str, TokenType.VARIABLE));
476                                                } else if (inOperator) {
477                                                        result.add(new Token(str, TokenType.OPERATOR));
478                                                } else {
479                                                        result.add(new Token(str, TokenType.LITERAL));
480                                                }
481                                        }
482                                }
483                                inOperator = false;
484                                currToken.delete(0, 1000000);
485                                continue;
486                        }
487                        
488                        if (!inQuote && (curr == ' ' || curr == '\t')) {
489                                if (currToken.length() > 0) {
490                                        String str = currToken.toString();
491                                        if (str.startsWith("$")) {
492                                                result.add(new Token(str, TokenType.VARIABLE));
493                                        } else if (inOperator) {
494                                                result.add(new Token(str, TokenType.OPERATOR));
495                                        } else {
496                                                result.add(new Token(str, TokenType.LITERAL));
497                                        }
498                                }
499                                inOperator = false;
500                                currToken.delete(0, 1000000);
501                                continue;
502                        }
503                        
504                        if (!inQuote && !inOperator && isOperatorChar(curr) && (curr != '-' || !isDigit(next))) {
505                                if (currToken.length() > 0) {
506                                        String str = currToken.toString();
507                                        if (str.startsWith("$")) {
508                                                result.add(new Token(str, TokenType.VARIABLE));
509                                        } else {
510                                                result.add(new Token(str, TokenType.LITERAL));
511                                        }
512                                }
513                                currToken.delete(0, 1000000);
514                                inOperator = true;
515                                if (charEscaped && curr == 'n') {
516                                        currToken.append("\n");
517                                } else {
518                                        currToken.append(curr);
519                                }
520                                continue;
521                        }
522                        
523                        if (!inQuote && inOperator && !isOperatorChar(curr)) {
524                                if (currToken.length() > 0) {
525                                        String str = currToken.toString();
526                                        result.add(new Token(str, TokenType.OPERATOR));
527                                }
528                                currToken.delete(0, 1000000);
529                                inOperator = false;
530                                if (charEscaped && curr == 'n') {
531                                        currToken.append("\n");
532                                } else {
533                                        currToken.append(curr);
534                                }
535                                continue;
536                        }
537                        
538                        if (charEscaped && curr == 'n') {
539                                currToken.append("\n");
540                        } else {
541                                currToken.append(curr);
542                        }
543                }
544                
545                if (inQuote) {
546                        throw new RuleException("Unmatched quotes in string: " + string + "]");
547                }
548                
549                if (currToken.length() > 0) {
550                        String str = currToken.toString();
551                        if (str.startsWith("$")) {
552                                result.add(new Token(str, TokenType.VARIABLE));
553                        } else if (inOperator) {
554                                result.add(new Token(str, TokenType.OPERATOR));
555                        } else {
556                                result.add(new Token(str, TokenType.LITERAL));
557                        }
558                }
559        
560                return result;
561        }

565                if (c == 0) return false;
566                String digits = "1234567890";
567                return digits.contains("" + c);
568        }
569        private static boolean isOperatorChar(char c) {
570                String operatorChars = "=<>!+-";
571                return operatorChars.contains("" + c);
572        }

588        public static String replaceTokensFromMemory(String text, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
589                List<String> keySet = new ArrayList<String>(memoryMap.keySet());
590                if (keySet.contains(MemKeys.LOCAL)) {
591                        keySet.remove(MemKeys.LOCAL);
592                        keySet.add(0, MemKeys.LOCAL);
593                }
594                for (String key : keySet) {
595                        MemoryAPI memory = memoryMap.get(key);
596                        List<String> keys = new ArrayList<String>(memory.getKeys());
597                        Collections.sort(keys, new Comparator<String>() {
598                                public int compare(String o1, String o2) {
599                                        return o2.length() - o1.length();
600                                }
601                        });
602                        for (String token : keys) {
603                                Object value = memory.get(token);
604                                if (value == null) value = "null";
605                                if (value instanceof String || value instanceof Boolean || value instanceof Float || value instanceof Integer) {
606                                        text = text.replaceAll("(?s)\\$" + Pattern.quote(key) + "\\." + Pattern.quote(token.substring(1)), value.toString());
607                                        text = text.replaceAll("(?s)\\$" + Pattern.quote(token.substring(1)), value.toString());
608                                }
609                        }
610                }
611                return text;
612        }

655        public static float getRounded(float in) {
656                if (in <= 10) return Math.max(1, (int) in);
657                float pow = (int) Math.log10(in);
658                float div = (float) Math.pow(10, Math.max(0, pow - 1));
659                if (pow == 1) div = 10;
660                return (int) Math.round(in / div) * div;
661        }

663        public static String getRoundedValue(float value) {
664                if (Math.abs((float)Math.round(value) - value) < 0.0001f) {
665                        //if (value > 10 || value < -10) {
666                                return String.format("%d", (int) Math.round(value));
667                        //} else {
668                                //return String.format("%.1f", value);
669                        //}
670                } else if ((int) Math.round((value * 100f)) == (int) Math.round((value * 10f)) * 10) {
671                        return (value > 10 || value < -10) ? "" + (int) Math.round(value) : String.format("%.1f", value);
672                } else {
673                        return (value > 10 || value < -10) ? "" + (int) Math.round(value) : String.format("%.2f", value);
674                }
675        }
676        
677        public static float getRoundedValueFloat(float value) {
678                if (Math.abs((float)Math.round(value) - value) < 0.0001f) {
679                        return (int) Math.round(value);
680                } else if ((int) Math.round((value * 100f)) == (int) Math.round((value * 10f)) * 10) {
681                        return (value > 10 || value < -10) ? (int) Math.round(value) :
682                                                (Math.round(value * 10f) / 10f);
683                } else {
684                        return (value > 10 || value < -10) ? (int) Math.round(value) :
685                                                (Math.round(value * 100f) / 100f);
686                }
687        }

693                        return (value >= 10 || value <= -10) ? "" + (int) Math.round(value) : String.format("%.1f", value);
694                } else {
695                        return (value >= 10 || value <= -10) ? "" + (int) Math.round(value) : String.format("%.1f", value);

898        public static String getJoined(String joiner, String ... strings) {
899                if (strings.length == 1) return strings[0];
900                
901                String result = "";
902                for (int i = 0; i < strings.length - 1; i++) {
903                        result += strings[i] + ", ";
904                }
905                if (!result.isEmpty()) {
906                        result = result.substring(0, result.length() - 2);
907                }
908                if (strings.length > 2) {
909                        if (joiner.isEmpty()) {
910                                result += ", " + strings[strings.length - 1];
911                        } else {
912                                result += ", " + joiner + " " + strings[strings.length - 1];
913                        }
914                } else if (strings.length == 2) {
915                        if (joiner.isEmpty()) {
916                                result += ", " + strings[strings.length - 1];
917                        } else {
918                                result += " " + joiner + " " + strings[strings.length - 1];
919                        }
920                }
921                return result;
922        }

1162        public static MarketAPI findNearestLocalMarket(SectorEntityToken token, float maxDist, MarketFilter filter) {
1163                List<MarketAPI> localMarkets = getMarketsInLocation(token.getContainingLocation());
1164                float distToLocalMarket = Float.MAX_VALUE;
1165                MarketAPI closest = null;
1166                for (MarketAPI market : localMarkets) {
1167                        if (filter != null && !filter.acceptMarket(market)) continue;
1168                        
1169                        if (market.getPrimaryEntity() == null) continue;
1170                        if (market.getPrimaryEntity().getContainingLocation() != token.getContainingLocation()) continue;
1171                        
1172                        float currDist = Misc.getDistance(market.getPrimaryEntity().getLocation(), token.getLocation());
1173                        if (currDist > maxDist) continue;
1174                        if (currDist < distToLocalMarket) {
1175                                distToLocalMarket = currDist;
1176                                closest = market;
1177                        }
1178                }
1179                return closest;
1180        }
1181        public static List<MarketAPI> findNearbyLocalMarkets(SectorEntityToken token, float maxDist, MarketFilter filter) {
1182                List<MarketAPI> localMarkets = getMarketsInLocation(token.getContainingLocation());
1183                List<MarketAPI> result = new ArrayList<MarketAPI>();
1184                
1185                for (MarketAPI market : localMarkets) {
1186                        if (filter != null && !filter.acceptMarket(market)) continue;
1187                        if (market.getPrimaryEntity() == null) continue;
1188                        if (market.getPrimaryEntity().getContainingLocation() != token.getContainingLocation()) continue;
1189                        
1190                        float currDist = Misc.getDistance(market.getPrimaryEntity().getLocation(), token.getLocation());
1191                        if (currDist > maxDist) continue;
1192                        
1193                        result.add(market);
1194                        
1195                }
1196                return result;
1197        }

1211        public static float RAD_PER_DEG = 0.01745329251f;
1212        public static Vector2f getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(float degrees) {
1213                Vector2f result = new Vector2f();
1214                float radians = degrees * RAD_PER_DEG;
1215                result.x = (float)Math.cos(radians);
1216                result.y = (float)Math.sin(radians);
1217                
1218                return result;
1219        }
1220        
1221        public static Vector2f rotateAroundOrigin(Vector2f v, float angle) {
1222                float cos = (float) Math.cos(angle * RAD_PER_DEG);
1223                float sin = (float) Math.sin(angle * RAD_PER_DEG);
1224                Vector2f r = new Vector2f();
1225                r.x = v.x * cos - v.y * sin;
1226                r.y = v.x * sin + v.y * cos;
1227                return r;
1228        }
1229        
1230        public static Vector2f rotateAroundOrigin(Vector2f v, float angle, Vector2f origin) {
1231                float cos = (float) Math.cos(angle * RAD_PER_DEG);
1232                float sin = (float) Math.sin(angle * RAD_PER_DEG);
1233                Vector2f r = Vector2f.sub(v, origin, new Vector2f());
1234                Vector2f r2 = new Vector2f();
1235                r2.x = r.x * cos - r.y * sin;
1236                r2.y = r.x * sin + r.y * cos;
1237                Vector2f.add(r2, origin, r2);
1238                return r2;
1239        }

1241        /**
1242         * Angles.
1243         * @param one
1244         * @param two
1245         * @param check
1246         * @return
1247         */
1248        public static boolean isBetween(float one, float two, float check) {
1249                one = normalizeAngle(one);
1250                two = normalizeAngle(two);
1251                check = normalizeAngle(check);
1252
1253                //System.out.println(one + "," + two + "," + check);
1254                if (check >= one && check <= two) return true;
1255                
1256                if (one > two) {
1257                        if (check <= two) return true;
1258                        if (check >= one) return true;
1259                }
1260                return false;
1261        }

1263        public static float getShieldedCargoFraction(CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
1264                float shielded = 0f;
1265                for (FleetMemberAPI member : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
1266                        if (member.isMothballed()) continue;
1267                        if (member.getVariant().hasHullMod(HullMods.SHIELDED_CARGO_HOLDS)) {
1268                                shielded += member.getCargoCapacity();
1269                        }
1270                }
1271                float max = fleet.getCargo().getMaxCapacity();
1272                if (max < 1) return 0f;
1273                return shielded / max;
1274        }

1277        public static Color interpolateColor(Color from, Color to, float progress) {
1278                float red = (float)from.getRed() + ((float)to.getRed() - (float)from.getRed()) * progress;
1279                float green = (float)from.getGreen() + ((float)to.getGreen() - (float)from.getGreen()) * progress;
1280                float blue = (float)from.getBlue() + ((float)to.getBlue() - (float)from.getBlue()) * progress;
1281                float alpha = (float)from.getAlpha() + ((float)to.getAlpha() - (float)from.getAlpha()) * progress;
1282                red = Math.round(red);
1283                green = Math.round(green);
1284                blue = Math.round(blue);
1285                alpha = Math.round(alpha);
1286                return new Color((int)red, (int)green, (int)blue, (int)alpha);
1287        }

1292                                (int) (min.getBlue() + (max.getBlue() - min.getBlue()) * random.nextDouble()),
1293                                255);
1294

1300                
1301                v.x += (to.x - from.x) * progress;
1302                v.y += (to.y - from.y) * progress;
1303                
1304                return v;
1305        }

1370        public static float getClosingSpeed(Vector2f p1, Vector2f p2, Vector2f v1, Vector2f v2) {               
1371                // direction from target to shooter
1372                Vector2f dir = Vector2f.sub(p1, p2, new Vector2f());
1373                normalise(dir);
1374                // velocity of target relative to shooter
1375                Vector2f relVel = Vector2f.sub(v2, v1, new Vector2f());
1376                float closingSpeed = Vector2f.dot(dir, relVel);
1377                return closingSpeed;
1378        }

1412        public static Vector2f getInterceptPointBasic(SectorEntityToken from, SectorEntityToken to) {
1413                float dist = getDistance(from.getLocation(), to.getLocation()) - from.getRadius() - to.getRadius();
1414                if (dist <= 0) return new Vector2f(to.getLocation());
1415                
1416                float closingSpeed = getClosingSpeed(from.getLocation(), to.getLocation(), from.getVelocity(), to.getVelocity());
1417                if (closingSpeed <= 10) return new Vector2f(to.getLocation());
1418                
1419                Vector2f toTarget = getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(Misc.getAngleInDegrees(from.getLocation(), to.getLocation()));
1420                Vector2f vel = new Vector2f(from.getVelocity());
1421                normalise(vel);
1422                float dot = Vector2f.dot(toTarget, vel);
1423                if (dot < 0) return new Vector2f(to.getLocation());
1424//              if (to.isPlayerFleet()) {
1425//                      System.out.println("23rwefe");
1426//              }
1427                float time = dist / closingSpeed;
1428                
1429                Vector2f point = new Vector2f(to.getVelocity());
1430                point.scale(time);
1431                Vector2f.add(point, to.getLocation(), point);
1432                return point;
1433        }

1437        /**
1438         * A flag can be set to true for several "reasons". As long as it hasn't been set
1439         * back to false for all of the "reasons", it will remain set to true.
1440         * 
1441         * For example, a fleet may be hostile because it's responding to comm relay interference,
1442         * and because the player is running with the transponder off. Until both are resolved,
1443         * the "hostile" flag will remain set to true.
1444         * 
1445         * Note: a flag can not be "set" to false. If it's set to false for all the current reasons,
1446         * the key is removed from memory. 
1447         * 
1448         * Returns whether the flag is still set after this method does its work.
1449         * @param memory
1450         * @param flagKey
1451         * @param reason
1452         * @param value
1453         * @return
1454         */
1455        public static boolean setFlagWithReason(MemoryAPI memory, String flagKey, String reason, boolean value, float expire) {
1456                String requiredKey = flagKey + "_" + reason;
1457
1458                if (value) {
1459                        memory.set(flagKey, true);
1460                        memory.set(requiredKey, value, expire);
1461                        memory.addRequired(flagKey, requiredKey);
1462                } else {
1463                        memory.unset(requiredKey);
1464                }
1465                
1466                return memory.contains(flagKey);
1467        }
1468        
1469        public static boolean flagHasReason(MemoryAPI memory, String flagKey, String reason) {
1470                String requiredKey = flagKey + "_" + reason;
1471                
1472                return memory.getBoolean(requiredKey);
1473        }
1474        
1475        public static void clearFlag(MemoryAPI memory, String flagKey) {
1476                for (String req : memory.getRequired(flagKey)) {
1477                        memory.unset(req);
1478                }
1479        }

1542        public static String getAgoStringForTimestamp(long timestamp) {
1543                CampaignClockAPI clock = Global.getSector().getClock();
1544                float days = clock.getElapsedDaysSince(timestamp);
1545                
1546                if (days <= 1f) {
1547                        return "Today";
1548                } else if (days <= 6f) {
1549                        return (int)Math.ceil(days) + " days ago";
1550                } else if (days <= 7) {
1551                        return "1 week ago";
1552                } else if (days <= 14) {
1553                        return "2 weeks ago";
1554                } else if (days <= 21) {
1555                        return "3 weeks ago";
1556                } else if (days <= 30 + 14) {
1557                        return "1 month ago";
1558                } else if (days < 30 * 2 + 14) {
1559                        return "2 months ago";
1560                } else if (days < 30 * 3 + 14) {
1561                        return "3 months ago";
1562                } else {
1563                        return "Over 3 months ago";
1564                }
1565        }

1567        public static String getDetailedAgoString(long timestamp) {
1568                CampaignClockAPI clock = Global.getSector().getClock();
1569                int days = (int) clock.getElapsedDaysSince(timestamp);
1570                
1571                if (days == 0) {
1572                        return "0 days ago";
1573                } else if (days == 1) {
1574                        return "1 day ago";
1575                } else if (days <= 6) {
1576                        return (int)Math.ceil(days) + " days ago";
1577                } else if (days <= 7) {
1578                        return "1 week ago";
1579                } else if (days <= 14) {
1580                        return "2 weeks ago";
1581                } else if (days <= 21) {
1582                        return "3 weeks ago";
1583                } else {
1584                        int months = days / 30;
1585                        if (months <= 12) {
1586                                if (months <= 1) {
1587                                        return "1 month ago";
1588                                } else {
1589                                        return "" + months + " months ago";
1590                                }
1591                        } else {
1592                                int years = months / 12;
1593                                if (years <= 1) {
1594                                        return "1 cycle ago";
1595                                } else {
1596                                        return "" + years + " cycles ago";
1597                                }
1598                        }
1599                }
1600        }

1668        public static float getBurnLevelForSpeed(float speed) {
1669                speed -= Global.getSettings().getBaseTravelSpeed();
1670                if (speed < 0 || speed <= Global.getSettings().getFloat("minTravelSpeed") + 1f) speed = 0;
1671                float currBurn = speed / Global.getSettings().getSpeedPerBurnLevel();

1738        public static boolean isInArc(float direction, float arc, Vector2f from, Vector2f to) {
1739                direction = normalizeAngle(direction);
1740                if (arc >= 360) return true;
1741                if (direction < 0) direction = 360 + direction;
1742                Vector2f towardsTo = new Vector2f(to.x - from.x, to.y - from.y);
1743                if (towardsTo.lengthSquared() == 0) return false;
1744                float dir = Misc.getAngleInDegrees(towardsTo);
1745                if (dir < 0) dir = 360 + dir;
1746                float arcFrom = direction - arc/2f;
1747                if (arcFrom < 0) arcFrom = 360 + arcFrom;
1748                if (arcFrom > 360) arcFrom -= 360;
1749                float arcTo = direction + arc/2f;
1750                if (arcTo < 0) arcTo = 360 + arcTo;
1751                if (arcTo > 360) arcTo -= 360;
1752                
1753                if (dir >= arcFrom && dir <= arcTo) return true;
1754                if (dir >= arcFrom && arcFrom > arcTo) return true;
1755                if (dir <= arcTo && arcFrom > arcTo) return true;
1756                return false;
1757        }

1759        public static boolean isInArc(float direction, float arc, float test) {
1760                test = normalizeAngle(test);
1761                
1762                if (arc >= 360) return true;
1763                if (direction < 0) direction = 360 + direction;
1764                float dir = test;
1765                if (dir < 0) dir = 360 + dir;
1766                float arcFrom = direction - arc/2f;
1767                if (arcFrom < 0) arcFrom = 360 + arcFrom;
1768                if (arcFrom > 360) arcFrom -= 360;
1769                float arcTo = direction + arc/2f;
1770                if (arcTo < 0) arcTo = 360 + arcTo;
1771                if (arcTo > 360) arcTo -= 360;
1772                
1773                if (dir >= arcFrom && dir <= arcTo) return true;
1774                if (dir >= arcFrom && arcFrom > arcTo) return true;
1775                if (dir <= arcTo && arcFrom > arcTo) return true;
1776                return false;
1777        }

1874        /**
1875         * Shortest distance from line to a point.
1876         * @param p1 line1
1877         * @param p2 line2
1878         * @param p3 point
1879         * @return
1880         */
1881        public static float distanceFromLineToPoint(Vector2f p1, Vector2f p2, Vector2f p3) {
1882                float u = (p3.x - p1.x) * (p2.x - p1.x) + (p3.y - p1.y) * (p2.y - p1.y);
1883                float denom = Vector2f.sub(p2, p1, new Vector2f()).length();
1884                denom *= denom;
1885                //if (denom == 0) return 0;
1886                u /= denom;
1887                Vector2f i = new Vector2f();
1888                i.x = p1.x + u * (p2.x - p1.x);
1889                i.y = p1.y + u * (p2.y - p1.y);
1890                return Vector2f.sub(i, p3, new Vector2f()).length();
1891        }
1892        
1893        public static Vector2f closestPointOnLineToPoint(Vector2f p1, Vector2f p2, Vector2f p3) {
1894                float u = (p3.x - p1.x) * (p2.x - p1.x) + (p3.y - p1.y) * (p2.y - p1.y);
1895                float denom = Vector2f.sub(p2, p1, new Vector2f()).length();
1896                denom *= denom;
1897                if (denom == 0) return p1;
1898                u /= denom;
1899                Vector2f i = new Vector2f();
1900                i.x = p1.x + u * (p2.x - p1.x);
1901                i.y = p1.y + u * (p2.y - p1.y);
1902                return i;
1903        }
1904        
1905        public static Vector2f closestPointOnSegmentToPoint(Vector2f p1, Vector2f p2, Vector2f p3) {
1906                float u = (p3.x - p1.x) * (p2.x - p1.x) + (p3.y - p1.y) * (p2.y - p1.y);
1907                float denom = Vector2f.sub(p2, p1, new Vector2f()).length();
1908                denom *= denom;
1909                
1910                u /= denom;
1911                
1912                // if closest point on line is outside the segment, clamp to on the segment
1913                if (u < 0) u = 0;
1914                if (u > 1) u = 1;
1915                
1916                Vector2f i = new Vector2f();
1917                i.x = p1.x + u * (p2.x - p1.x);
1918                i.y = p1.y + u * (p2.y - p1.y);
1919                return i;
1920        }

1922        public static boolean isPointInBounds(Vector2f p1, List<Vector2f> bounds) {
1923                Vector2f p2 = new Vector2f(p1);
1924                p2.x += 10000;
1925                int count = 0;
1926                for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
1927                        for (int j = 0; j < bounds.size() - 1; j++) {
1928                                Vector2f s1 = bounds.get(j);
1929                                Vector2f s2 = bounds.get(j + 1);
1930                                Vector2f p = intersectSegments(p1, p2, s1, s2);
1931                                if (p != null) {
1932                                        if (Math.abs(p.x - s1.x) < 0.001f && 
1933                                                Math.abs(p.y - s1.y) < 0.001f) {
1934                                                continue; // JUST the first point, (p1, p2]
1935                                        }
1936                                        if (areSegmentsCoincident(p1, p2, s1, s2)) {
1937                                                continue;
1938                                        }
1939                                        count++;
1940                                }
1941                        }
1942                        if (i == 0 && count % 2 == 1) {
1943                                count = 0;
1944                                p2.y += 100;
1945                        } else {
1946                                break;
1947                        }
1948                }
1949                return count % 2 == 1;
1950        }

1952        public static Vector2f intersectSegments(Vector2f a1, Vector2f a2, Vector2f b1, Vector2f b2) {
1953                float denom = (b2.y - b1.y) * (a2.x - a1.x) - (b2.x - b1.x) * (a2.y - a1.y);
1954                float numUa = (b2.x - b1.x) * (a1.y - b1.y) - (b2.y - b1.y) * (a1.x - b1.x);
1955                float numUb = (a2.x - a1.x) * (a1.y - b1.y) - (a2.y - a1.y) * (a1.x - b1.x);
1956
1957                if (denom == 0 && !(numUa == 0 && numUb == 0)) { // parallel, not coincident
1958                        return null;
1959                }
1960
1961                if (denom == 0 && numUa == 0 && numUb == 0) { // coincident
1962                        float minX, minY, maxX, maxY;
1963                        if (a1.x < a2.x) {
1964                                minX = a1.x;
1965                                maxX = a2.x;
1966                        } else {
1967                                minX = a2.x;
1968                                maxX = a1.x;
1969                        }
1970                        if (a1.y < a2.y) {
1971                                minY = a1.y;
1972                                maxY = a2.y;
1973                        } else {
1974                                minY = a2.y;
1975                                maxY = a1.y;
1976                        }
1977                        // if either one of the endpoints in segment b is between the points in segment a,
1978                        // return that endpoint as the intersection.  Otherwise, no intersection.
1979                        if (b1.x >= minX && b1.x <= maxX && b1.y >= minY && b1.y <= maxY) {
1980                                return new Vector2f(b1);
1981                        } else if (b2.x >= minX && b2.x <= maxX && b2.y >= minY && b2.y <= maxY) {
1982                                return new Vector2f(b2);
1983                        } else {
1984                                return null;
1985                        }
1986                }
1987
1988                float Ua = numUa / denom;
1989                float Ub = numUb / denom;
1990                if (Ua >=0 && Ua <= 1 && Ub >= 0 && Ub <= 1) { // segments intersect
1991                        Vector2f result = new Vector2f();
1992//                      if (Ua <= 0.001f) {
1993//                              result.x = a1.x;
1994//                              result.y = a1.y;
1995//                      } else if (Ua >= 0.999f) {
1996//                              result.x = a2.x;
1997//                              result.y = a2.y;
1998//                      } else {
1999                                result.x = a1.x + Ua * (a2.x - a1.x);
2000                                result.y = a1.y + Ua * (a2.y - a1.y);
2001//                      }
2002                        return result;
2003                } else { // lines intersect, but segments do not
2004                        return null;
2005                }
2006
2007        }

2010        public static Vector2f intersectLines(Vector2f a1, Vector2f a2, Vector2f b1, Vector2f b2) {
2011                float denom = (b2.y - b1.y) * (a2.x - a1.x) - (b2.x - b1.x) * (a2.y - a1.y);
2012                float numUa = (b2.x - b1.x) * (a1.y - b1.y) - (b2.y - b1.y) * (a1.x - b1.x);
2013                float numUb = (a2.x - a1.x) * (a1.y - b1.y) - (a2.y - a1.y) * (a1.x - b1.x);
2014
2015                if (denom == 0 && !(numUa == 0 && numUb == 0)) { // parallel, not coincident
2016                        return null;
2017                }
2018
2019                if (denom == 0 && numUa == 0 && numUb == 0) { // coincident
2020                        return new Vector2f(a1);
2021                }
2022
2023                float Ua = numUa / denom;
2024                float Ub = numUb / denom;
2025                Vector2f result = new Vector2f();
2026                result.x = a1.x + Ua * (a2.x - a1.x);
2027                result.y = a1.y + Ua * (a2.y - a1.y);
2028                return result;
2029        }

2034        /**
2035         * Going from p1 to p2.  Returns the closer intersection.
2036         * @param p1
2037         * @param p2
2038         * @param p3
2039         * @param r
2040         * @return
2041         */
2042        public static Vector2f intersectSegmentAndCircle(Vector2f p1, Vector2f p2, Vector2f p3, float r) {
2043
2044                float uNom = (p3.x - p1.x) * (p2.x - p1.x) + (p3.y - p1.y) * (p2.y - p1.y);
2045                float uDenom = (p2.x - p1.x) * (p2.x - p1.x) + (p2.y - p1.y) * (p2.y - p1.y);
2046
2047                Vector2f closest = new Vector2f();
2048                if (uDenom == 0) { // p1 and p2 are coincident
2049                        closest.set(p1);
2050                } else {
2051                        float u = uNom / uDenom;
2052                        closest.x = p1.x + u * (p2.x - p1.x);
2053                        closest.y = p1.y + u * (p2.y - p1.y);
2054                }
2055
2056                float distSq = (closest.x - p3.x) * (closest.x - p3.x) + (closest.y - p3.y) * (closest.y - p3.y);
2057                if (distSq > r * r) { // closest point is farther than radius
2058                        //System.out.println("shorted");
2059                        return null;
2060                } else if (uDenom == 0) {
2061                        return closest; // in the case where p1==p2 and they're inside the circle, return p1.
2062                }
2063
2064                float a = (p2.x - p1.x) * (p2.x - p1.x) + (p2.y - p1.y) * (p2.y - p1.y);
2065                float b = 2f * ( (p2.x - p1.x) * (p1.x - p3.x) + (p2.y - p1.y) *
2066                                (p1.y - p3.y) );
2067                float c = p3.x * p3.x + p3.y * p3.y + p1.x * p1.x + p1.y * p1.y - 2f
2068                                * (p3.x * p1.x + p3.y * p1.y) - r * r;
2069
2070                float bb4ac = b * b - 4f * a * c;
2071
2072                if (bb4ac < 0) return null;
2073
2074                float mu1 = (-b + (float) Math.sqrt(bb4ac)) / (2 * a);
2075                float mu2 = (-b - (float) Math.sqrt(bb4ac)) / (2 * a);
2076
2077                float minMu = mu1;
2078                if ((mu2 < minMu && mu2 >= 0) || minMu < 0) minMu = mu2;
2079
2080                if (minMu < 0 || minMu > 1) {
2081                        float p2DistSq = (p2.x - p3.x) * (p2.x - p3.x) + (p2.y - p3.y) * (p2.y - p3.y);
2082                        if (p2DistSq <= r * r) return p2;
2083                        else return null;
2084                }
2085                //System.out.println("mu1: " + mu1 + ", mu2: " + mu2);
2086
2087                Vector2f result = new Vector2f();
2088                result.x = p1.x + minMu * (p2.x - p1.x);
2089                result.y = p1.y + minMu * (p2.y - p1.y);
2090
2091                return result;
2092        }

2095        public static boolean areSegmentsCoincident(Vector2f a1, Vector2f a2, Vector2f b1, Vector2f b2) {
2096                float denom = (b2.y - b1.y) * (a2.x - a1.x) - (b2.x - b1.x) * (a2.y - a1.y);
2097                float numUa = (b2.x - b1.x) * (a1.y - b1.y) - (b2.y - b1.y) * (a1.x - b1.x);
2098                float numUb = (a2.x - a1.x) * (a1.y - b1.y) - (a2.y - a1.y) *(a1.x - b1.x);
2099
2100                if (denom == 0 && !(numUa == 0 && numUb == 0)) { // parallel, not coincident
2101                        return false;
2102                }
2103
2104                if (denom == 0 && numUa == 0 && numUb == 0) { // coincident
2105                        return true;
2106                }
2107                
2108                return false;
2109        }

2205        public static float getSpawnChanceMult(Vector2f locInHyper) {
2206                if (Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet() == null) return 1f;
2207                
2208                float min = Global.getSettings().getFloat("minFleetSpawnChanceMult");
2209                float range = Global.getSettings().getFloat("minFleetSpawnChanceRangeLY");
2210                
2211                Vector2f playerLoc = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getLocationInHyperspace();
2212                float distLY = getDistanceLY(playerLoc, locInHyper);
2213                
2214                float f = (1f - Math.min(1f, distLY/range));
2215                return min + (1f - min) * f * f;
2216        }

2218        public static Vector2f pickHyperLocationNotNearPlayer(Vector2f from, float minDist) {
2219                CampaignFleetAPI player = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
2220                float r = 2000f;
2221                if (player == null || !player.isInHyperspace()) {
2222                        return getPointWithinRadius(from, r);
2223                }
2224                float dist = Misc.getDistance(player.getLocation(), from);
2225                if (dist > minDist + r) {
2226                        return getPointWithinRadius(from, r);
2227                }
2228                float dir = Misc.getAngleInDegrees(player.getLocation(), from);
2229                Vector2f v = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(dir);
2230                v.scale(minDist + 2000 - dist);
2231                Vector2f.add(v, from, v);
2232                return getPointWithinRadius(v, r);
2233        }

2562        public static interface FindShipFilter {
2563                public boolean matches(ShipAPI ship);
2564        }

2566        public static ShipAPI findClosestShipEnemyOf(ShipAPI ship, Vector2f locFromForSorting, HullSize smallestToNote, float maxRange, boolean considerShipRadius) {
2567                return findClosestShipEnemyOf(ship, locFromForSorting, smallestToNote, maxRange, considerShipRadius, null);
2568        }
2569        public static ShipAPI findClosestShipEnemyOf(ShipAPI ship, Vector2f locFromForSorting, HullSize smallestToNote, float maxRange, boolean considerShipRadius, FindShipFilter filter) {
2570                CombatEngineAPI engine = Global.getCombatEngine();
2571                List<ShipAPI> ships = engine.getShips();
2572                float minDist = Float.MAX_VALUE;
2573                ShipAPI closest = null;
2574                for (ShipAPI other : ships) {
2575                        if (other.getHullSize().ordinal() < smallestToNote.ordinal()) continue;
2576                        if (other.isShuttlePod()) continue;
2577                        if (other.isHulk()) continue;
2578                        if (ship.getOwner() != other.getOwner() && other.getOwner() != 100) {
2579                                if (filter != null && !filter.matches(other)) continue;
2580                                
2581                                float dist = getDistance(ship.getLocation(), other.getLocation());
2582                                float distSort = getDistance(locFromForSorting, other.getLocation());
2583                                float radSum = ship.getCollisionRadius() + other.getCollisionRadius();
2584                                if (!considerShipRadius) radSum = 0;
2585                                if (dist > maxRange + radSum) continue;
2586                                if (distSort < minDist) {
2587                                        closest = other;
2588                                        minDist = distSort;
2589                                }
2590                        }
2591                }
2592                return closest;
2593        }

2595        public static ShipAPI findClosestShipTo(ShipAPI ship, Vector2f locFromForSorting, HullSize smallestToNote, float maxRange, boolean considerShipRadius, boolean allowHulks, FindShipFilter filter) {
2596                CombatEngineAPI engine = Global.getCombatEngine();
2597                List<ShipAPI> ships = engine.getShips();
2598                float minDist = Float.MAX_VALUE;
2599                ShipAPI closest = null;
2600                for (ShipAPI other : ships) {
2601                        if (other == ship) continue;
2602                        if (other.getHullSize().ordinal() < smallestToNote.ordinal()) continue;
2603                        if (other.isShuttlePod()) continue;
2604                        if (other.isHulk()) continue;
2605                        if (allowHulks || other.getOwner() != 100) {
2606                                if (filter != null && !filter.matches(other)) continue;
2607                                
2608                                float dist = getDistance(ship.getLocation(), other.getLocation());
2609                                float distSort = getDistance(locFromForSorting, other.getLocation());
2610                                float radSum = ship.getCollisionRadius() + other.getCollisionRadius();
2611                                if (!considerShipRadius) radSum = 0;
2612                                if (dist > maxRange + radSum) continue;
2613                                if (distSort < minDist) {
2614                                        closest = other;
2615                                        minDist = distSort;
2616                                }
2617                        }
2618                }
2619                return closest;
2620        }

2625        }
2626        public static <T extends Enum<T>> T mapToEnum(JSONObject json, String key, Class<T> enumType, T defaultOption, boolean required) throws JSONException {
2627                String val = json.optString(key);
2628                if (val == null || val.equals("")) {
2629                        if (defaultOption == null && required) {
2630                                throw new RuntimeException("Key [" + key + "] is required");
2631                        }
2632                        return defaultOption;
2633                }
2634                try {
2635                        return (T) Enum.valueOf(enumType, val);
2636                } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
2637                        throw new RuntimeException("Key [" + key + "] has invalid value [" + val + "] in [" + json.toString() + "]");
2638                }
2639        }

2694        public static void normalizeNoise(float[][] noise) {
2695                float minNoise = 1;
2696                float maxNoise = 0;
2697                for (int i = 0; i < noise.length; i++) {
2698                        for (int j = 0; j < noise[0].length; j++) {
2699                                if (noise[i][j] != -1) {
2700                                        if (noise[i][j] > maxNoise)
2701                                                maxNoise = noise[i][j];
2702                                        if (noise[i][j] < minNoise)
2703                                                minNoise = noise[i][j];
2704                                }
2705                        }
2706                }
2707                
2708                if (minNoise >= maxNoise) return;
2709
2710                float range = maxNoise - minNoise;
2711
2712                for (int i = 0; i < noise.length; i++) {
2713                        for (int j = 0; j < noise[0].length; j++) {
2714                                if (noise[i][j] != -1) {
2715                                        float newNoise = (noise[i][j] - minNoise) / range;
2716                                        noise[i][j] = newNoise;
2717                                } else {
2718                                        if (i > 0)
2719                                                noise[i][j] = noise[i - 1][j];
2720                                        else if (i < noise.length - 1)
2721                                                noise[i][j] = noise[i + 1][j];
2722                                        else
2723                                                noise[i][j] = .5f;
2724                                }
2725                        }
2726                }
2727        }
2728
2729        public static float [][] initNoise(Random random, int w, int h, float spikes) {
2730                if (random == null) random = Misc.random;
2731                float [][] noise = new float [w][h];
2732                for (int i = 0; i < noise.length; i++) {
2733                        for (int j = 0; j < noise[0].length; j++) {
2734                                noise[i][j] = -1f;
2735                        }
2736                }
2737                noise[0][0] = random.nextFloat() * spikes;
2738                noise[0][noise[0].length - 1] = random.nextFloat() * spikes;
2739                noise[noise.length - 1][0] = random.nextFloat() * spikes;
2740                noise[noise.length - 1][noise[0].length - 1] = random.nextFloat() * spikes;
2741                return noise;
2742        }
2743        
2744        public static void genFractalNoise(Random random, float[][] noise, int x1, int y1,
2745                                                                                int x2, int y2, int iter, float spikes) {
2746                if (x1 + 1 >= x2 || y1 + 1 >= y2) return; // no more values to fill
2747
2748                int midX = (x1 + x2) / 2;
2749                int midY = (y1 + y2) / 2;
2750
2751                fill(random, noise, midX, y1, x1, y1, x2, y1, iter, spikes);
2752                fill(random, noise, midX, y2, x1, y2, x2, y2, iter, spikes);
2753                fill(random, noise, x1, midY, x1, y1, x1, y2, iter, spikes);
2754                fill(random, noise, x2, midY, x2, y1, x2, y2, iter, spikes);
2755                
2756                // averaging 4 neighboring values
2757                fill(random, noise, midX, midY, midX, y1, midX, y2, iter, spikes);
2758                float midValue1 = noise[midX][midY];
2759                fill(random, noise, midX, midY, x1, midY, x2, midY, iter, spikes);
2760                float midValue2 = noise[midX][midY];
2761                noise[midX][midY] = (midValue1 + midValue2)/2f;
2762
2763                genFractalNoise(random, noise, x1, y1, midX, midY, iter + 1, spikes);
2764                genFractalNoise(random, noise, x1, midY, midX, y2, iter + 1, spikes);
2765                genFractalNoise(random, noise, midX, y1, x2, midY, iter + 1, spikes);
2766                genFractalNoise(random, noise, midX, midY, x2, y2, iter + 1, spikes);
2767        }
2768
2769        private static void fill(Random random, float[][] noise, int x, int y, int x1, int y1,
2770                        int x2, int y2, int iter, float spikes) {
2771                if (noise[x][y] == -1) {
2772                        float avg = (noise[x1][y1] + noise[x2][y2]) / 2f;
2773                        noise[x][y] = avg + ((float) Math.pow(spikes, (iter)) * (float) (random.nextFloat() - .5));
2774                }
2775        }

2778        public static float computeAngleSpan(float radius, float range) {
2779                if (range <= 1) return 180f;
2780                return (2f * radius) / (2f * (float) Math.PI * range) * 360f;
2781        }
2782        
2783        public static float computeAngleRadius(float angle, float range) {
2784                float rad = (float) Math.toRadians(angle);
2785                return rad * range;
2786        }

2788        public static float approach(float curr, float dest, float minSpeed,  float diffSpeedMult, float amount) {
2789                float diff = dest - curr;
2790                float delta = (Math.signum(diff) * minSpeed + (diff * diffSpeedMult)) * amount;
2791                
2792                if (Math.abs(delta) > Math.abs(diff)) delta = diff;
2793                return curr + delta;
2794        }

2796        public static Map<Class, Method> cleanerCache = new LinkedHashMap<>();
2797        public static Map<Class, Method> cleanCache = new LinkedHashMap<>();
2798    
2799        public static void cleanBuffer(Buffer toBeDestroyed) {
2800        try {
2801                
2802                Method cleanerMethod = cleanerCache.get(toBeDestroyed.getClass());
2803                if (cleanerMethod == null) {
2804                        cleanerMethod = toBeDestroyed.getClass().getMethod("cleaner");
2805                        if (cleanerMethod != null) {
2806                                cleanerMethod.setAccessible(true);
2807                                cleanerCache.put(toBeDestroyed.getClass(), cleanerMethod);
2808                        }
2809                }
2810                if (cleanerMethod != null) {
2811                        Object cleaner = cleanerMethod.invoke(toBeDestroyed);
2812                        if (cleaner != null) {
2813                                Method cleanMethod = cleanCache.get(cleaner.getClass());
2814                                if (cleanMethod == null) {
2815                                        cleanMethod = cleaner.getClass().getMethod("clean");
2816                                        if (cleanMethod != null) {
2817                                                cleanMethod.setAccessible(true);
2818                                                cleanCache.put(cleaner.getClass(), cleanMethod);
2819                                        }
2820                                }
2821                                if (cleanMethod != null) {
2822                                        cleanMethod.invoke(cleaner);
2823                                        Global.getLogger(Misc.class).info(String.format("Cleaned buffer (using reflection)"));
2824                                } else {
2825                                        Global.getLogger(Misc.class).warn(String.format("Buffer can not be cleaned"));
2826                                }
2827                        } else {
2828                                Global.getLogger(Misc.class).warn(String.format("Buffer can not be cleaned"));
2829                        }
2830                } else {
2831                        Global.getLogger(Misc.class).warn(String.format("Buffer can not be cleaned"));
2832                }
2833        } catch (Exception e) {
2834                Global.getLogger(Misc.class).warn(e.getMessage(), e);
2835        }
2836    }

2999        public static int getEstimatedOrbitIndex(PlanetAPI planet) {
3000                Vector2f centerLoc = new Vector2f();
3001                float centerRadius = 0;
3002
3003//              if (planet.getId().toLowerCase().equals("asharu")) {
3004//                      System.out.println("sdfwefe");
3005//              }
3006                
3007                float planetRadius = planet.getRadius();
3008                PlanetAPI parent = null;
3009                PlanetAPI parentParent = null;
3010                if (planet.getOrbitFocus() instanceof PlanetAPI) {
3011                        parent = (PlanetAPI) planet.getOrbitFocus();
3012                        if (parent.getOrbitFocus() instanceof PlanetAPI) {
3013                                parentParent = (PlanetAPI) parent.getOrbitFocus();
3014                        }
3015                        if (parent.isStar()) {
3016                                centerLoc = parent.getLocation();
3017                                centerRadius = parent.getRadius();
3018                        } else if (parentParent != null && parentParent.isStar()) {
3019                                centerLoc = parentParent.getLocation();
3020                                centerRadius = parentParent.getRadius();
3021                                planetRadius = parent.getRadius();
3022                        }
3023                }
3024                
3025                float approximateExtraRadiusPerOrbit = 400f; 
3026                
3027                float dist = Misc.getDistance(centerLoc, planet.getLocation());
3028                int orbitIndex = (int) ((dist - centerRadius - planetRadius - 
3029                                                                StarSystemGenerator.STARTING_RADIUS_STAR_BASE - StarSystemGenerator.STARTING_RADIUS_STAR_RANGE * 0.5f) /
3030                                                                        (StarSystemGenerator.BASE_INCR * 1.25f + approximateExtraRadiusPerOrbit));
3031                if (orbitIndex == 0) {
3032                        orbitIndex = (int) ((dist - centerRadius - planetRadius - 
3033                                        StarSystemGenerator.STARTING_RADIUS_STAR_BASE - StarSystemGenerator.STARTING_RADIUS_STAR_RANGE * 0.5f) /
3034                                                (StarSystemGenerator.BASE_INCR * 1.25f));
3035                }
3036                if (orbitIndex < 0) orbitIndex = 0;
3037                
3038                return orbitIndex;
3039        }

3180        public static void renderQuadAlpha(float x, float y, float width, float height, Color color, float alphaMult) {
3181                
3182                GL11.glDisable(GL11.GL_TEXTURE_2D);
3183                GL11.glEnable(GL11.GL_BLEND);
3184                GL11.glBlendFunc(GL11.GL_SRC_ALPHA, GL11.GL_ZERO);
3185
3186                GL11.glColor4ub((byte)color.getRed(),
3187                                                (byte)color.getGreen(),
3188                                                (byte)color.getBlue(),
3189                                                (byte)(color.getAlpha() * alphaMult));
3190                
3191                GL11.glBegin(GL11.GL_QUADS);
3192                {
3193                        GL11.glVertex2f(x, y);
3194                        GL11.glVertex2f(x, y + height);
3195                        GL11.glVertex2f(x + width, y + height);
3196                        GL11.glVertex2f(x + width, y);
3197                }
3198                GL11.glEnd();
3199        }

3205        public static void fadeAndExpire(final SectorEntityToken entity, final float seconds) {
3206                if (entity.hasTag(Tags.FADING_OUT_AND_EXPIRING)) return;
3207                
3208                entity.addTag(Tags.NON_CLICKABLE);
3209                entity.addTag(Tags.FADING_OUT_AND_EXPIRING);
3210                //entity.getContainingLocation().addScript(new EveryFrameScript() {
3211                entity.addScript(new EveryFrameScript() {
3212                        float elapsed = 0f;
3213                        public boolean runWhilePaused() {
3214                                return false;
3215                        }
3216                        public boolean isDone() {
3217                                return entity.isExpired();
3218                        }
3219                        public void advance(float amount) {
3220                                elapsed += amount;
3221                                if (elapsed > seconds) {
3222                                        entity.setExpired(true);
3223                                }
3224                                float b = 1f - elapsed / seconds;
3225                                if (b < 0) b = 0;
3226                                if (b > 1) b = 1;
3227                                entity.forceSensorFaderBrightness(Math.min(entity.getSensorFaderBrightness(), b));
3228                                entity.setAlwaysUseSensorFaderBrightness(true);
3229                        }
3230                });
3231        }
3232        public static void fadeInOutAndExpire(final SectorEntityToken entity, final float in, final float dur, final float out) {
3233                entity.addTag(Tags.NON_CLICKABLE);
3234                entity.forceSensorFaderBrightness(0f);
3235                entity.setAlwaysUseSensorFaderBrightness(true);
3236                //entity.getContainingLocation().addScript(new EveryFrameScript() {
3237                entity.addScript(new EveryFrameScript() {
3238                        float elapsed = 0f;
3239                        public boolean runWhilePaused() {
3240                                return false;
3241                        }
3242                        public boolean isDone() {
3243                                return entity.isExpired();
3244                        }
3245                        public void advance(float amount) {
3246                                elapsed += amount;
3247                                if (elapsed > in + dur + out) {
3248                                        entity.setExpired(true);
3249                                }
3250                                float b = 1f;
3251                                if (elapsed < in) {
3252                                        b = elapsed / in;
3253                                } else if (elapsed > in + dur) {
3254                                        b = 1f - (elapsed - in - dur) / out;
3255                                }
3256                                if (b < 0) b = 0;
3257                                if (b > 1) b = 1;
3258                                entity.forceSensorFaderBrightness(Math.min(entity.getSensorFaderBrightness(), b));
3259                                entity.setAlwaysUseSensorFaderBrightness(true);
3260                        }
3261                });
3262        }

3264        public static void fadeIn(final SectorEntityToken entity, final float in) {
3265                entity.forceSensorFaderBrightness(0f);
3266                entity.setAlwaysUseSensorFaderBrightness(true);
3267                entity.addScript(new EveryFrameScript() {
3268                        float elapsed = 0f;
3269                        public boolean runWhilePaused() {
3270                                return false;
3271                        }
3272                        public boolean isDone() {
3273                                return elapsed > in;
3274                        }
3275                        public void advance(float amount) {
3276                                elapsed += amount;
3277                                if (elapsed > in) {
3278                                        entity.setAlwaysUseSensorFaderBrightness(false);
3279                                        return;
3280                                }
3281                                float b = elapsed / in;
3282                                if (b < 0) b = 0;
3283                                if (b > 1) b = 1;
3284                                entity.forceSensorFaderBrightness(Math.min(entity.getSensorFaderBrightness(), b));
3285                                entity.setAlwaysUseSensorFaderBrightness(true);
3286                        }
3287                });
3288        }

3386        public static boolean isShipRecoverable(FleetMemberAPI member, CampaignFleetAPI recoverer, boolean own, boolean useOfficerRecovery, float chanceMult) {
3387                //Random rand = new Random(1000000 * (member.getId().hashCode() + seed + Global.getSector().getClock().getDay()));
3388                //Random rand = new Random(1000000 * (member.getId().hashCode() + Global.getSector().getClock().getDay()));
3389                if (own) {
3390                        if (!member.getVariant().getSMods().isEmpty()) {
3391                                return true;
3392                        }
3393                        if (!member.getVariant().getSModdedBuiltIns().isEmpty()) {
3394                                return true;
3395                        }
3396                        if (member.getCaptain() != null && !member.getCaptain().isDefault()) {
3397                                return true;
3398                        }
3399                }
3400                if (member.getVariant().hasTag(Tags.VARIANT_ALWAYS_RECOVERABLE)) {
3401                        return true;
3402                }
3403                Random rand = new Random(1000000 * member.getId().hashCode() + Global.getSector().getPlayerBattleSeed());
3404                //rand = new Random();
3405                float chance = Global.getSettings().getFloat("baseShipRecoveryChance");
3406                if (own) {
3407                        chance = Global.getSettings().getFloat("baseOwnShipRecoveryChance");
3408                }
3409                chance = member.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.INDIVIDUAL_SHIP_RECOVERY_MOD).computeEffective(chance);
3410                if (recoverer != null) {
3411                        chance = recoverer.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.SHIP_RECOVERY_MOD).computeEffective(chance);
3412                        if (useOfficerRecovery) {
3413                                chance = recoverer.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.OFFICER_SHIP_RECOVERY_MOD).computeEffective(chance);
3414                        }
3415                }
3416                chance *= chanceMult;
3417                
3418                if (chance < 0) chance = 0;
3419                if (chance > 1f) chance = 1f;
3420                boolean recoverable = rand.nextFloat() < chance; 
3421                
3422//              System.out.println("Recovery for " + member.getHullSpec().getHullId() + 
3423//                              "(" + member.getId().hashCode() + "): " + chance + " (" + recoverable + ")");
3424                return recoverable;
3425        }

3438        public static JumpPointAPI findNearestJumpPointTo(SectorEntityToken entity, boolean allowWormhole) {
3439                float min = Float.MAX_VALUE;
3440                JumpPointAPI result = null;
3441                List<JumpPointAPI> points = entity.getContainingLocation().getEntities(JumpPointAPI.class);
3442                
3443                for (JumpPointAPI curr : points) {
3444                        if (!allowWormhole && curr.isWormhole()) continue;
3445                        if (curr.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(JumpPointInteractionDialogPluginImpl.UNSTABLE_KEY)) {
3446                                continue;
3447                        }
3448                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(entity.getLocation(), curr.getLocation());
3449                        if (dist < min) {
3450                                min = dist;
3451                                result = curr;
3452                        }
3453                }
3454                return result;
3455        }

3544        private static final AtomicLong seedUniquifier = new AtomicLong(8682522807148012L);
3545        
3546        /**
3547         * How Java generates a seed for a new java.util.Random() instance.
3548         * @return
3549         */
3550        public static long genRandomSeed() {
3551                return seedUniquifier() ^ System.nanoTime();
3552        }
3553        public static long seedUniquifier() {
3554                // L'Ecuyer, "Tables of Linear Congruential Generators of
3555                // Different Sizes and Good Lattice Structure", 1999
3556                for (;;) {
3557                        long current = seedUniquifier.get();
3558                        long next = current * 181783497276652981L;
3559                        //long next = current * 1181783497276652981L; // actual correct number?
3560                        if (seedUniquifier.compareAndSet(current, next)) {
3561                                return next;
3562                        }
3563                }
3564        }

3633        public static float getDistanceFromArc(float direction, float arc, float angle) {
3634                direction = normalizeAngle(direction);
3635                angle = normalizeAngle(angle);
3636        
3637                float dist1 = Math.abs(angle - direction) - arc/2f;
3638                float dist2 = Math.abs(360 - Math.abs(angle - direction)) - arc/2f;
3639                
3640                if (dist1 <= 0 || dist2 <= 0) return 0;
3641                
3642                return dist1 > dist2 ? dist2 : dist1;
3643        }

3788        public static WeightedRandomPicker<String> createStringPicker(Random random, Object ... params) {
3789                WeightedRandomPicker<String> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
3790                for (int i = 0; i < params.length; i += 2) {
3791                        String item = (String) params[i];
3792                        float weight = 0f;
3793                        if (params[i+1] instanceof Float) {
3794                                weight = (Float) params[i+1];
3795                        } else if (params[i+1] instanceof Integer) {
3796                                weight = (Integer) params[i+1];
3797                        }
3798                        picker.add(item, weight);
3799                }
3800                return picker;
3801        }

3817        public static List<CampaignFleetAPI> getNearbyFleets(SectorEntityToken from, float maxDist) {
3818                List<CampaignFleetAPI> result = new ArrayList<CampaignFleetAPI>();
3819                for (CampaignFleetAPI other : from.getContainingLocation().getFleets()) {
3820                        if (from == other) continue;
3821                        float dist = getDistance(from.getLocation(), other.getLocation());
3822                        if (dist <= maxDist) {
3823                                result.add(other);
3824                        }
3825                }
3826                return result;
3827        }

3829        public static List<CampaignFleetAPI> getVisibleFleets(SectorEntityToken from, boolean includeSensorContacts) {
3830                List<CampaignFleetAPI> result = new ArrayList<CampaignFleetAPI>();
3831                for (CampaignFleetAPI other : from.getContainingLocation().getFleets()) {
3832                        if (from == other) continue;
3833                        VisibilityLevel level = other.getVisibilityLevelTo(from);
3834                        if (level == VisibilityLevel.COMPOSITION_AND_FACTION_DETAILS || level == VisibilityLevel.COMPOSITION_DETAILS) {
3835                                result.add(other);
3836                        } else if (level == VisibilityLevel.SENSOR_CONTACT && includeSensorContacts) {
3837                                result.add(other);
3838                        }
3839                }
3840                return result;
3841        }
