3843        public static boolean isSameCargo(CargoAPI baseOne, CargoAPI baseTwo) {
3844                CargoAPI one = Global.getFactory().createCargo(true);
3845                one.addAll(baseOne);
3846                one.sort();
3847                
3848                CargoAPI two = Global.getFactory().createCargo(true);
3849                two.addAll(baseTwo);
3850                two.sort();
3851        
3852
3853                if (one.getStacksCopy().size() != two.getStacksCopy().size()) return false;
3854                
3855                List<CargoStackAPI> stacks1 = one.getStacksCopy();
3856                List<CargoStackAPI> stacks2 = two.getStacksCopy();
3857                for (int i = 0; i < stacks1.size(); i++) {
3858                        CargoStackAPI s1 = stacks1.get(i);
3859                        CargoStackAPI s2 = stacks2.get(i);
3860                        
3861                        if ((s1 == null || s2 == null) && s1 != s2) return false;
3862                        if (s1.getSize() != s2.getSize()) return false;
3863                        if (s1.getType() != s2.getType()) return false;
3864                        if ((s1.getData() == null || s2.getData() == null) && s1.getData() != s2.getData()) return false;
3865                        if (!s1.getData().equals(s2.getData())) return false;
3866                }
3867                
3868                
3869                return true;
3870        }

3873        public static JumpPointAPI getDistressJumpPoint(StarSystemAPI system) {
3874                SectorEntityToken jumpPoint = null;
3875                float minDist = Float.MAX_VALUE;
3876                for (SectorEntityToken curr : system.getJumpPoints()) {
3877                        if (curr instanceof JumpPointAPI && ((JumpPointAPI)curr).isWormhole()) {
3878                                continue;
3879                        }
3880                        
3881                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(system.getCenter().getLocation(), curr.getLocation());
3882                        if (dist < minDist) {
3883                                jumpPoint = curr;
3884                                minDist = dist;
3885                        }
3886                }
3887                if (jumpPoint instanceof JumpPointAPI) {
3888                        return (JumpPointAPI) jumpPoint;
3889                }
3890                return null;
3891        }

3916        public static void giveStandardReturnToSourceAssignments(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, boolean withClear) {
3917                if (withClear) {
3918                        fleet.clearAssignments();
3919                        fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(FLEET_RETURNING_TO_DESPAWN, true);
3920                        
3921                        MemoryAPI mem = fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
3922                        mem.unset(MemFlags.FLEET_MILITARY_RESPONSE);
3923                        mem.unset(MemFlags.FLEET_NO_MILITARY_RESPONSE);
3924                        mem.set(MemFlags.FLEET_BUSY, true);
3925                        fleet.removeScriptsOfClass(EconomyFleetAssignmentAI.class);
3926                        fleet.removeScriptsOfClass(PatrolAssignmentAIV4.class);
3927                }
3928                MarketAPI source = Misc.getSourceMarket(fleet);
3929                //MarketAPI source = null;
3930                if (source != null) {
3931                        fleet.addAssignment(FleetAssignment.GO_TO_LOCATION, source.getPrimaryEntity(), 1000f, "returning to " + source.getName());
3932                        fleet.addAssignment(FleetAssignment.ORBIT_PASSIVE, source.getPrimaryEntity(), 1f + 1f * (float) Math.random());
3933                        fleet.addAssignment(FleetAssignment.GO_TO_LOCATION_AND_DESPAWN, source.getPrimaryEntity(), 1000f);
3934                } else {
3935                        SectorEntityToken entity = getSourceEntity(fleet);
3936                        if (entity != null) {
3937                                fleet.addAssignment(FleetAssignment.GO_TO_LOCATION, entity, 1000f, "returning to " + entity.getName());
3938                                fleet.addAssignment(FleetAssignment.ORBIT_PASSIVE, entity, 1f + 1f * (float) Math.random());
3939                                fleet.addAssignment(FleetAssignment.GO_TO_LOCATION_AND_DESPAWN, entity, 1000f);
3940                        } else {
3941                                SectorEntityToken token = Global.getSector().getHyperspace().createToken(0, 0);
3942                                fleet.addAssignment(FleetAssignment.GO_TO_LOCATION_AND_DESPAWN, token, 1000f);
3943                        }
3944                }
3945        }

4008        public static Vector2f getInterceptPoint(CampaignFleetAPI from, SectorEntityToken to) {
4009                
4010                //if (true) return new Vector2f(to.getLocation());
4011                //Vector2f v1 = new Vector2f(from.getVelocity());
4012                //Vector2f v2 = new Vector2f(to.getVelocity());
4013                Vector2f v2 = Vector2f.sub(to.getVelocity(), from.getVelocity(), new Vector2f());
4014                
4015                float s1 = from.getTravelSpeed();
4016                float s2 = v2.length();
4017                
4018                if (s1 < 10) s1 = 10;
4019                if (s2 < 10) s2 = 10;
4020                
4021                Vector2f p1 = new Vector2f(from.getLocation());
4022                Vector2f p2 = new Vector2f(to.getLocation());
4023                
4024                float dist = getDistance(p1, p2);
4025                float time = dist / s1;
4026                float maxTime = dist / s2 * 0.75f;
4027                if (time > maxTime) time = maxTime; // to ensure intercept point is never behind the from fleet
4028                
4029                Vector2f p3 = getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(getAngleInDegrees(v2));
4030                
4031                p3.scale(time * s2);
4032                Vector2f.add(p2, p3, p3);
4033                
4034                Vector2f overshoot = getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(getAngleInDegrees(p1, p3));
4035                overshoot.scale(3000f);
4036                Vector2f.add(p3, overshoot, p3);
4037                
4038                return p3;
4039        }

4041        public static Vector2f getInterceptPoint(SectorEntityToken from, SectorEntityToken to, float maxSpeedFrom) {
4042                
4043                //if (true) return new Vector2f(to.getLocation());
4044                //Vector2f v1 = new Vector2f(from.getVelocity());
4045                //Vector2f v2 = new Vector2f(to.getVelocity());
4046                Vector2f v2 = Vector2f.sub(to.getVelocity(), from.getVelocity(), new Vector2f());
4047                
4048                float s1 = maxSpeedFrom;
4049                float s2 = v2.length();
4050                
4051                if (s1 < 10) s1 = 10;
4052                if (s2 < 10) s2 = 10;
4053                
4054                Vector2f p1 = new Vector2f(from.getLocation());
4055                Vector2f p2 = new Vector2f(to.getLocation());
4056                
4057                float dist = getDistance(p1, p2);
4058                float time = dist / s1;
4059                float maxTime = dist / s2 * 0.75f;
4060                if (time > maxTime) time = maxTime; // to ensure intercept point is never behind the from fleet
4061                
4062                Vector2f p3 = getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(getAngleInDegrees(v2));
4063                
4064                p3.scale(time * s2);
4065                Vector2f.add(p2, p3, p3);
4066                
4067                Vector2f overshoot = getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(getAngleInDegrees(p1, p3));
4068                overshoot.scale(3000f);
4069                Vector2f.add(p3, overshoot, p3);
4070                
4071                return p3;
4072        }

4116        public static boolean doesMarketHaveMissionImportantPeopleOrIsMarketMissionImportant(SectorEntityToken entity) {
4117                MarketAPI market = entity.getMarket();
4118                if (market == null) return false;
4119                if (market.getPrimaryEntity() != entity) return false;
4120                
4121                if (market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.ENTITY_MISSION_IMPORTANT)) return true;
4122                
4123                if (market != null && market.getCommDirectory() != null) {
4124                        for (CommDirectoryEntryAPI entry : market.getCommDirectory().getEntriesCopy()) {
4125                                if (entry.getType() == EntryType.PERSON && entry.getEntryData() instanceof PersonAPI) {
4126                                        PersonAPI person = (PersonAPI) entry.getEntryData();
4127                                        if (person.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.ENTITY_MISSION_IMPORTANT)) {
4128                                                return true;
4129                                        }
4130                                }
4131                        }
4132                }
4133                return false;
4134        }

4175        public static void cleanUpMissionMemory(MemoryAPI memory, String prefix) {
4176                List<String> unset = new ArrayList<String>();
4177                for (String key : memory.getKeys()) {
4178                        if (key.startsWith("$" + prefix)) {
4179                                unset.add(key);
4180                        }
4181                }
4182                for (String key : unset) {
4183                        memory.unset(key);
4184                }
4185                
4186                if (prefix.endsWith("_")) {
4187                        prefix = prefix.substring(0, prefix.length() - 1);
4188                }
4189                
4190                Misc.setFlagWithReason(memory, MemFlags.ENTITY_MISSION_IMPORTANT,
4191                                                       prefix, false, 0f);
4192        }

4195        public static void clearAreaAroundPlayer(float minDist) {
4196                CampaignFleetAPI player = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
4197                if (player == null) return;
4198                
4199                for (CampaignFleetAPI other : player.getContainingLocation().getFleets()) {
4200                        if (player == other) continue;
4201                        if (other.getBattle() != null) continue;
4202                        if (other.getOrbit() != null) continue;
4203                        if (!other.isHostileTo(player)) continue;
4204                        
4205                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(player.getLocation(), other.getLocation());
4206                        if (dist < minDist) {
4207                                float angle = Misc.getAngleInDegrees(player.getLocation(), other.getLocation());
4208                                Vector2f v = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(angle);
4209                                v.scale(minDist);
4210                                Vector2f.add(v, other.getLocation(), v);
4211                                other.setLocation(v.x, v.y);
4212                        }
4213                }
4214        }

4219        public static long getSalvageSeed(SectorEntityToken entity, boolean nonRandom) {
4220                long seed = entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getLong(MemFlags.SALVAGE_SEED);
4221                if (seed == 0) {
4222                        //seed = new Random().nextLong();
4223                        String id = entity.getId();
4224                        if (id == null) id = genUID();
4225                        if (nonRandom) {
4226                                seed = (entity.getId().hashCode() * 17000) * 1181783497276652981L;
4227                        } else {
4228                                seed = seedUniquifier() ^ (entity.getId().hashCode() * 17000);
4229                        }
4230                        Random r = new Random(seed);
4231                        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
4232                                r.nextLong();
4233                        }
4234                        long result = r.nextLong();
4235                        entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.SALVAGE_SEED, result);
4236                        return result;
4237                }
4238                return seed;
4239        }

4250                }
4251                long result = r.nextLong();
4252                return result;

4279                if (fleet.getMoveDestination() == null) return 0f;
4280                
4281                if (fleet.wasSlowMoving()) {
4282                        Vector2f vel = fleet.getVelocity();
4283                        Vector2f neg = new Vector2f(vel);
4284                        neg.negate();
4285                        return getAngleInDegrees(neg);

4287                
4288                return getAngleInDegrees(fleet.getLocation(), fleet.getMoveDestination());

4357        public static float getMarketSizeProgress(MarketAPI market) {
4358                ImmigrationPlugin plugin = getImmigrationPlugin(market);
4359                float min = plugin.getWeightForMarketSize(market.getSize());
4360                float max = plugin.getWeightForMarketSize(market.getSize() + 1);
4361                
4362                float curr = market.getPopulation().getWeightValue();
4363                
4364                if (max <= min) return 0f;
4365                
4366                float f = (curr - min) / (max - min);
4367                if (f < 0) f = 0;
4368                if (f > 1) f = 1;
4369                return f;
4370        }

4410        public static float getStorageCargoValue(MarketAPI market) {
4411                SubmarketPlugin plugin = getStorage(market);
4412                if (plugin == null) return 0f;
4413                float value = 0f;
4414                for (CargoStackAPI stack : plugin.getCargo().getStacksCopy()) {
4415                        value += stack.getSize() * stack.getBaseValuePerUnit();
4416                }
4417                return value;
4418        }

4420        public static float getStorageShipValue(MarketAPI market) {
4421                SubmarketPlugin plugin = getStorage(market);
4422                if (plugin == null) return 0f;
4423                float value = 0f;
4424                
4425                for (FleetMemberAPI member : plugin.getCargo().getMothballedShips().getMembersListCopy()) {
4426                        float extMult = Misc.isExtended() ? Global.getSettings().optFloatFromArray("ext_shipBuyPriceMult", 
4427                                                                member.getHullSpec().getHullSize().ordinal() - 2, 1f) : 1f;
4428                        extMult *= Misc.isExtended() ? Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_shipStoragePriceMult") : 1f;
4429                        value += member.getBaseValue() * extMult;
4430                }
4431                return value;
4432        }

4435        /**
4436         * Returns true if it added anything to the tooltip.
4437         * @return
4438         */
4439        public static boolean addStorageInfo(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, Color color, Color dark, MarketAPI market,
4440                                                                                 //boolean showFees,
4441                                                                                 boolean includeLocalResources, boolean addSectionIfEmpty) {
4442                SubmarketPlugin storage = Misc.getStorage(market);
4443                SubmarketPlugin local = Misc.getLocalResources(market);
4444                
4445                CargoAPI cargo = Global.getFactory().createCargo(true);
4446                List<FleetMemberAPI> ships = new ArrayList<FleetMemberAPI>();
4447                if (storage != null) {
4448                        cargo.addAll(storage.getCargo());
4449                        ships.addAll(storage.getCargo().getMothballedShips().getMembersListCopy());
4450                }
4451                if (local != null && includeLocalResources) {
4452                        cargo.addAll(local.getCargo());
4453                        ships.addAll(local.getCargo().getMothballedShips().getMembersListCopy());
4454                }
4455                
4456                float opad = 15f;
4457                if (!cargo.isEmpty() || addSectionIfEmpty) {
4458                        String title = "Cargo in storage";
4459                        if (includeLocalResources && local != null) {
4460                                title = "Cargo in storage and resource stockpiles";
4461                        }
4462                        tooltip.addSectionHeading(title, color, dark, Alignment.MID, opad);
4463                        opad = 10f;
4464                        tooltip.showCargo(cargo, 10, true, opad);
4465                }
4466                
4467                if (!ships.isEmpty() || addSectionIfEmpty) {
4468                        String title = "Ships in storage";
4469                        if (includeLocalResources && local != null) {
4470                                title = "Ships in storage";
4471                        }
4472                        tooltip.addSectionHeading(title, color, dark, Alignment.MID, opad);
4473                        opad = 10f;
4474                        tooltip.showShips(ships, 10, true, opad);
4475                }
4476                
4477                if (!market.isPlayerOwned()) {
4478                        int cost = getStorageCostPerMonth(market);
4479                        if (cost > 0) {
4480                                tooltip.addPara("Monthly storage fee: %s", opad, getHighlightColor(), getDGSCredits(cost));
4481                        }
4482                }
4483                
4484                if (addSectionIfEmpty) return true;
4485                
4486                return !cargo.isEmpty() || !ships.isEmpty();
4487        }

4518        }
4519        public static float getOfficerSalary(PersonAPI officer, boolean mercenary, boolean checkIfInPopulatedSystem, 
4520                        boolean checkActive) {
4521                int officerBase = Global.getSettings().getInt("officerSalaryBase");
4522                int officerPerLevel = Global.getSettings().getInt("officerSalaryPerLevel");
4523                
4524                float payMult = 1f;
4525                if (mercenary) {
4526                        payMult = Global.getSettings().getFloat("officerMercPayMult");
4527                }
4528                if (checkActive && !isOfficerActive(officer)) {
4529                        payMult *= getOfficerInactiveSalaryMult();
4530                } else if (checkIfInPopulatedSystem) {
4531                        if (Misc.isInCivilizedSpace()) {
4532                                payMult *= Global.getSettings().getFloat("officerSalaryMultInPopulatedSystems");
4533                        }
4534                }
4535                
4536                float mult = isExtended() ? Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_officerSalaryMult") : 1f;
4537                payMult *= mult;
4538                
4539                float salary = (officerBase + officer.getStats().getLevel() * officerPerLevel) * payMult;
4540                return salary;
4541        }

4570        public static int getCombatPay(PersonAPI officer, FleetMemberAPI member) {
4571                if (!Misc.isExtended()) return 0;
4572                if (member == null || officer == null || 
4573                                officer.isDefault() || officer.isAICore() || officer.isPlayer()) {
4574                        return 0;
4575                }
4576                
4577                HullSize size = member.getHullSpec().getHullSize();
4578                
4579                CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
4580                if (playerFleet == null) return 0;
4581                
4582                boolean found = false;
4583                for (OfficerDataAPI od : playerFleet.getFleetData().getOfficersCopy()) {
4584                        if (officer== od.getPerson()) {
4585                                found = true;
4586                                break;
4587                        }
4588                }
4589                if (!found) return 0;
4590                
4591                float salary = getOfficerSalary(officer, isMercenary(officer), false, false);
4592                int index = size.ordinal() - 2;
4593                return (int)(salary * Global.getSettings().optFloatFromArray("ext_officerCombatPay", index, 1f));
4594        }

4728        public static ShipPickMode getShipPickMode(MarketAPI market, String factionId) {
4729                QualityData d = ShipQuality.getInstance().getQualityData(market);

4731                        if (factionId == null && d.market.getFaction() != market.getFaction()) {
4732                                return ShipPickMode.IMPORTED;

4736                        return ShipPickMode.PRIORITY_THEN_ALL;
4737                }
4738                return ShipPickMode.IMPORTED;

4850        public static float getProbabilityMult(float desired, float current, float deviationMult) {
4851                float deviation = desired * deviationMult;
4852                float exponent = (desired - current) / deviation;
4853                if (exponent > 4) exponent = 4;
4854                float probMult = (float) Math.pow(10f, exponent);
4855                return probMult;
4856        }

4872        public static void showCost(TextPanelAPI text, String title, boolean withAvailable, float widthOverride, Color color, Color dark, String [] res, int [] quantities, boolean [] consumed) {
4873                if (color == null) color = getBasePlayerColor();
4874                if (dark == null) dark = getDarkPlayerColor();
4875                
4876                Set<String> unmet = new HashSet<String>();
4877                Set<String> all = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
4878                
4879                CargoAPI cargo = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getCargo();
4880                
4881                for (int i = 0; i < res.length; i++) {
4882                        String commodityId = res[i];
4883                        int quantity = quantities[i];
4884                        if (quantity > cargo.getQuantity(CargoItemType.RESOURCES, commodityId)) {
4885                                unmet.add(commodityId);
4886                        }
4887                        all.add(commodityId);
4888                }
4889                
4890                float costHeight = 67;
4891                ResourceCostPanelAPI cost = text.addCostPanel(title, costHeight,
4892                                color, dark);
4893                cost.setNumberOnlyMode(true);
4894                cost.setWithBorder(false);
4895                cost.setAlignment(Alignment.LMID);
4896                
4897                if (!withAvailable && res.length > 4) {
4898                        widthOverride = 98;
4899                }
4900                
4901                if (widthOverride > 0) {
4902                        cost.setComWidthOverride(widthOverride);
4903                }
4904                
4905                boolean dgs = true;
4906                for (int i = 0; i < res.length; i++) {
4907                        String commodityId = res[i];
4908                        int required = quantities[i];
4909                        int available = (int) cargo.getCommodityQuantity(commodityId);
4910                        Color curr = color;
4911                        if (withAvailable && required > cargo.getQuantity(CargoItemType.RESOURCES, commodityId)) {
4912                                curr = Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor();
4913                        }
4914                        if (dgs) {
4915                                if (withAvailable) {
4916                                        cost.addCost(commodityId, Misc.getWithDGS(required) + " (" + Misc.getWithDGS(available) + ")", curr);
4917                                } else {
4918                                        cost.addCost(commodityId, Misc.getWithDGS(required), curr);
4919                                }
4920                                if (consumed != null && consumed[i]) {
4921                                        cost.setLastCostConsumed(true);
4922                                }
4923                        } else {
4924                                if (withAvailable) {
4925                                        cost.addCost(commodityId, "" + required + " (" + available + ")", curr);
4926                                } else {
4927                                        cost.addCost(commodityId, "" + required, curr);
4928                                }
4929                                if (consumed != null && consumed[i]) {
4930                                        cost.setLastCostConsumed(true);
4931                                }
4932                        }
4933                }
4934                cost.update();
4935        }

4971        /**
4972         * pair.one can be null if a stand-alone, non-market station is being returned in pair.two.
4973         * @param from
4974         * @return
4975         */
4976        public static Pair<SectorEntityToken, CampaignFleetAPI> getNearestStationInSupportRange(CampaignFleetAPI from) {
4977                SectorEntityToken closestEntity = null;
4978                CampaignFleetAPI closest = null;
4979                float minDist = Float.MAX_VALUE;
4980                for (SectorEntityToken station : from.getContainingLocation().getCustomEntitiesWithTag(Tags.STATION)) {
4981                        CampaignFleetAPI fleet = Misc.getStationFleet(station);
4982                        if (fleet == null || fleet.isEmpty()) continue;
4983                        
4984                        boolean ignore = fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate() != null && 
4985                                        fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.FLEET_IGNORES_OTHER_FLEETS);
4986                        if (ignore) continue;
4987                        
4988                        if (!isStationInSupportRange(from, fleet)) continue;
4989                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(from.getLocation(), station.getLocation());
4990                        
4991                        if (dist < minDist) {
4992                                closest = fleet;
4993                                closestEntity = station;
4994                                minDist = dist;
4995                        }
4996                }
4997                
4998                // remnant stations and other fleets that are in station mode, w/o a related market
4999                for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet : from.getContainingLocation().getFleets()) {
5000                        if (!fleet.isStationMode()) continue;
5001                        if (fleet.isHidden()) continue;
5002                        
5003                        boolean ignore = fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate() != null && 
5004                                        fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.FLEET_IGNORES_OTHER_FLEETS);
5005                        if (ignore) continue;
5006                        
5007                        if (!isStationInSupportRange(from, fleet)) continue;
5008                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(from.getLocation(), fleet.getLocation());
5009                        
5010                        if (dist < minDist) {
5011                                closest = fleet;
5012                                closestEntity = null;
5013                                minDist = dist;
5014                        }
5015                }
5016                
5017                if (closest == null) return null;
5018                
5019                return new Pair<SectorEntityToken, CampaignFleetAPI>(closestEntity, closest);
5020        }

5022        public static boolean isStationInSupportRange(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, CampaignFleetAPI station) {
5023                float check = Misc.getBattleJoinRange();
5024                float distPrimary = 10000f;
5025                MarketAPI market = getStationMarket(station);
5026                if (market != null) {
5027                        distPrimary = Misc.getDistance(fleet.getLocation(), market.getPrimaryEntity().getLocation());
5028                }
5029                float distStation = Misc.getDistance(fleet.getLocation(), station.getLocation());
5030                
5031                if (distPrimary > check && distStation > check) {
5032                        return false;
5033                }
5034                return true;
5035                
5036        }

5043        public static float getMemberStrength(FleetMemberAPI member, boolean withHull, boolean withQuality, boolean withCaptain) {
5044                float str = member.getMemberStrength();
5045                float min = 0.25f;
5046                if (str < min) str = min;
5047                
5048                float quality = 0.5f;
5049                float sMods = 0f;
5050                if (member.getFleetData() != null && member.getFleetData().getFleet() != null) {
5051                        CampaignFleetAPI fleet = member.getFleetData().getFleet();
5052                        if (fleet.getInflater() != null && !fleet.isInflated()) {
5053                                quality = fleet.getInflater().getQuality();
5054                                sMods = fleet.getInflater().getAverageNumSMods();
5055                        } else {
5056                                BattleAPI battle = fleet.getBattle();
5057                                CampaignFleetAPI source = battle == null ? null : battle.getSourceFleet(member);
5058                                if (source != null && source.getInflater() != null &&
5059                                                !source.isInflated()) {
5060                                        quality = source.getInflater().getQuality();
5061                                        sMods = source.getInflater().getAverageNumSMods();
5062                                } else {
5063                                        float dmods = DModManager.getNumDMods(member.getVariant());
5064                                        quality = 1f - Global.getSettings().getFloat("qualityPerDMod") * dmods;
5065                                        if (quality < 0) quality = 0f;
5066                                        
5067                                        sMods = member.getVariant().getSMods().size();
5068                                }
5069                        }
5070                }
5071                
5072                if (member.isStation()) {
5073                        quality = 1f;
5074                }
5075                
5076                if (sMods > 0) {
5077                        quality += sMods * Global.getSettings().getFloat("qualityPerSMod");
5078                }
5079                
5080                float captainMult = 1f;
5081                if (member.getCaptain() != null) {
5082                        float captainLevel = (member.getCaptain().getStats().getLevel() - 1f);
5083                        if (member.isStation()) {
5084                                captainMult += captainLevel / (MAX_OFFICER_LEVEL * 2f);
5085                        } else {
5086                                captainMult += captainLevel / MAX_OFFICER_LEVEL;
5087                        }
5088                }
5089                
5090                if (withQuality) {
5091                        //str *= Math.max(0.25f, 0.5f + quality);
5092                        str *= Math.max(0.25f, 0.8f + quality * 0.4f);
5093                }
5094                if (withHull) {
5095                        str *= 0.5f + 0.5f * member.getStatus().getHullFraction();
5096                }
5097                if (withCaptain) {
5098                        str *= captainMult;
5099                }
5100                //System.out.println("Member: " + member + ", str: " + str);
5101                
5102                return str;
5103        }

5179        public static float getFleetRadiusTerrainEffectMult(CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
5180                float min = Global.getSettings().getBaseFleetSelectionRadius() + Global.getSettings().getFleetSelectionRadiusPerUnitSize();
5181                float max = Global.getSettings().getMaxFleetSelectionRadius();
5182                float radius = fleet.getRadius();
5183                
5184                //radius = 1000;
5185
5186                float mult = (radius - min) / (max - min);
5187                if (mult > 1) mult = 1;
5188                //if (mult < 0) mult = 0;
5189                if (mult < MIN_TERRAIN_EFFECT_MULT) mult = MIN_TERRAIN_EFFECT_MULT;
5190                //mult = MIN_BURN_PENALTY + mult * BURN_PENALTY_RANGE;
5191
5192                float skillMod = fleet.getCommanderStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.NAVIGATION_PENALTY_MULT);
5193                mult *= skillMod;
5194                
5195                mult = Math.round(mult * 100f) / 100f;
5196                
5197                return mult;
5198        }

5205                mult = Math.round(mult * 100f) / 100f;
5206                if (mult < 0.1f) mult = 0.1f;
5207//              if (mult > 1) mult = 1;
5208                return mult;
5209        }

5294        public static FactionAPI getClaimingFaction(SectorEntityToken planet) {
5295                if (planet.getStarSystem() != null) {
5296                        String claimedBy = planet.getStarSystem().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getString(MemFlags.CLAIMING_FACTION);
5297                        if (claimedBy != null) {
5298                                return Global.getSector().getFaction(claimedBy);
5299                        }
5300                }
5301                
5302                int max = 0;
5303                MarketAPI result = null;
5304                List<MarketAPI> markets = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarkets(planet.getContainingLocation());
5305                for (MarketAPI curr : markets) {
5306                        if (curr.isHidden()) continue;
5307                        if (curr.getFaction().isPlayerFaction()) continue;
5308                        
5309                        int score = curr.getSize();
5310                        for (MarketAPI other : markets) {
5311                                if (other != curr && other.getFaction() == curr.getFaction()) score++;
5312                        }
5313                        if (isMilitary(curr)) score += 10;
5314                        if (score > max) {
5315                                JSONObject json = curr.getFaction().getCustom().optJSONObject(Factions.CUSTOM_PUNITIVE_EXPEDITION_DATA);
5316                                if (json == null) continue;
5317                                boolean territorial = json.optBoolean("territorial");
5318                                if (!territorial) continue;
5319                                
5320                                max = score;
5321                                result = curr;
5322                        }
5323                }
5324                if (result == null) return null;
5325                
5326                return result.getFaction();
5327        }

5344        public static int computeShutdownRefund(MarketAPI market, Industry industry) {
5345                float refund = 0;
5346                
5347                Industry upInd = null;
5348                if (industry.isUpgrading()) {
5349                        String up = industry.getSpec().getUpgrade();
5350                        if (up != null) {
5351                                upInd = market.instantiateIndustry(up);
5352                        }
5353                }
5354                if (industry.isUpgrading() && upInd != null) {
5355                        refund += upInd.getBuildCost();
5356                }
5357                
5358                float refundFraction = Global.getSettings().getFloat("industryRefundFraction");
5359                Industry curr = industry;
5360                while (curr != null) {
5361                        if (curr.isBuilding() && !curr.isUpgrading()) {
5362                                refund += curr.getBuildCost();
5363                        } else {
5364                                refund += curr.getBuildCost() * refundFraction;
5365                        }
5366                        String down = curr.getSpec().getDowngrade();
5367                        if (down != null) {
5368                                curr = market.instantiateIndustry(down);
5369                        } else {
5370                                curr = null;
5371                        }
5372                }
5373                
5374                return (int) refund;
5375        }

5422        public static Color setBrightness(Color color, int brightness) {
5423                float max = color.getRed();
5424                if (color.getGreen() > max) max = color.getGreen();
5425                if (color.getBlue() > max) max = color.getBlue();
5426                float f = brightness / max;
5427                color = scaleColorSaturate(color, f);
5428                return color;
5429        }
5430        
5431        public static Color scaleColorSaturate(Color color, float factor) {
5432                int red = (int) (color.getRed() * factor);
5433                int green = (int) (color.getGreen() * factor);
5434                int blue = (int) (color.getBlue() * factor);
5435                int alpha = (int) (color.getAlpha() * factor);
5436                
5437                if (red > 255) red = 255;
5438                if (green > 255) green = 255;
5439                if (blue > 255) blue = 255;
5440                if (alpha > 255) alpha = 255;
5441                
5442                return new Color(red, green, blue, alpha);
5443        }

5562        public static int getDangerLevel(CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
5563                if (fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains(DANGER_LEVEL_OVERRIDE)) {
5564                        return (int) fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getFloat(DANGER_LEVEL_OVERRIDE);
5565                }
5566                
5567                CampaignFleetAPI pf = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
5568                
5569                float playerStr = 0f;
5570                float fleetStr = 0f;
5571                for (FleetMemberAPI member : pf.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
5572                        float strength = Misc.getMemberStrength(member, true, true, true);
5573                        playerStr += strength;
5574                }
5575                
5576                for (FleetMemberAPI member : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
5577                        float strength = Misc.getMemberStrength(member, true, true, true);
5578                        fleetStr += strength;
5579                }
5580                
5581                if (playerStr > fleetStr * 3f) return 1;
5582                if (playerStr > fleetStr * 1.5f) return 2;
5583                if (playerStr > fleetStr * 0.75f) return 3;
5584                if (playerStr > fleetStr * 0.33f) return 4;
5585                return 5;
5586        }

5589        public static float getHitGlowSize(float baseSize, float baseDamage, ApplyDamageResultAPI result) {
5590                if (result == null || baseDamage <= 0) return baseSize;
5591                
5592                float sd = result.getDamageToShields() + result.getOverMaxDamageToShields();
5593                float ad = result.getTotalDamageToArmor();
5594                float hd = result.getDamageToHull();
5595                float ed = result.getEmpDamage();
5596                DamageType type = result.getType();
5597                return getHitGlowSize(baseSize, baseDamage, type, sd, ad, hd, ed);
5598        }
5599        
5600        
5601        public static float getHitGlowSize(float baseSize, float baseDamage, DamageType type, float sd, float ad, float hd, float ed) {
5602                
5603                float minBonus = 0f;
5604                if (type == DamageType.KINETIC) {
5605                        sd *= 0.5f;
5606                        //if (sd > 0) minBonus = 0.1f;
5607                } else if (type == DamageType.HIGH_EXPLOSIVE) {
5608                        ad *= 0.5f;
5609                        if (ad > 0) minBonus = 0.1f;
5610                } else if (type == DamageType.FRAGMENTATION) {
5611                        if (hd > 0) {
5612                                minBonus = 0.2f * (hd / (hd + ad));
5613                        }
5614                        sd *= 2f;
5615                        ad *= 2f;
5616                        hd *= 2f;
5617                }
5618                
5619                float totalDamage = sd + ad + hd;
5620                if (totalDamage <= 0) return baseSize;
5621                
5622                // emp damage makes the hitglow normal-sized, but not bigger
5623                if (totalDamage < baseDamage) {
5624                        totalDamage += ed;
5625                        if (totalDamage > baseDamage) {
5626                                totalDamage = baseDamage;
5627                        }
5628                }
5629                
5630                float minSize = 15f;
5631                float minMult = minSize / baseSize;
5632                minMult = Math.max(minMult, 0.67f + minBonus);
5633                if (minMult > 1) minMult = 1;
5634                
5635                float mult = totalDamage / baseDamage;
5636                if (mult < minMult) mult = minMult;
5637                
5638                float maxMult = 1.5f;
5639                if (mult > maxMult) mult = maxMult;
5640                //mult = maxMult;
5641                //mult = 1f;
5642                //System.out.println("Mult: " + mult);
5643                return baseSize * mult;
5644        }

5834        public static boolean isSpecialMod(ShipVariantAPI variant, HullModSpecAPI spec) {
5835//              if (spec.getId().equals(HullMods.ANDRADA_MODS)) {
5836//                      return true;fwewefwefe
5837//              }
5838                if (spec.isHidden()) return false;
5839                if (spec.isHiddenEverywhere()) return false;
5840                if (spec.hasTag(Tags.HULLMOD_DMOD)) return false;
5841                if (!variant.getPermaMods().contains(spec.getId())) return false;
5842                if (variant.getHullSpec().getBuiltInMods().contains(spec.getId())) return false;
5843                if (!variant.getSMods().contains(spec.getId())) return false;
5844                
5845                return true;
5846        }

5848        public static boolean hasSModdableBuiltIns(ShipVariantAPI variant) {
5849                if (!CAN_SMOD_BUILT_IN || variant == null) return false;
5850                int num = 0;
5851                for (String id : variant.getHullMods()) {
5852                        HullModSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getHullModSpec(id);
5853                        if (spec.isHidden()) continue;
5854                        if (spec.isHiddenEverywhere()) continue;
5855                        if (spec.hasTag(Tags.HULLMOD_DMOD)) continue;
5856                        if (variant.getHullSpec().isBuiltInMod(id) &&
5857                                        spec.getEffect().hasSModEffect() && !spec.getEffect().isSModEffectAPenalty() &&
5858                                        !variant.getSModdedBuiltIns().contains(id)) {
5859                                num++;
5860                        }
5861                }
5862                return num > 0;
5863        }

5914        public static enum FleetMemberDamageLevel {
5915                LOW,
5916                MEDIUM,
5917                HIGH,
5918        }
5919        
5920        public static void applyDamage(FleetMemberAPI member, Random random, FleetMemberDamageLevel level, 
5921                                                                   boolean withCRDamage, String crDamageId, String crDamageReason,
5922                                                                   boolean withMessage, TextPanelAPI textPanel, 
5923                                                                   String messageText) {
5924                float damageMult = 1f;
5925                switch (level) {
5926                case LOW:
5927                        damageMult = 3f;
5928                        break;
5929                case MEDIUM:
5930                        damageMult = 10f;
5931                        break;
5932                case HIGH:
5933                        damageMult = 20f;
5934                        break;
5935                }
5936                applyDamage(member, random, damageMult, withCRDamage, crDamageId, crDamageReason, 
5937                                        withMessage, textPanel, messageText);
5938        }
5939        
5940        public static void applyDamage(FleetMemberAPI member, Random random, float damageMult, 
5941                                boolean withCRDamage, String crDamageId, String crDamageReason,
5942                                boolean withMessage, TextPanelAPI textPanel, 
5943                                String messageText) {
5944                if (random == null) random = Misc.random;
5945                damageMult *= 0.75f + random.nextFloat() * 0.5f;
5946                
5947//              float hitStrength = 0f; 
5948//              hitStrength += member.getHullSpec().getArmorRating() * 0.1f;
5949//              hitStrength *= damageMult;
5950                
5951                // hull damage going to be overridden by hullDamageFraction, anyway
5952                // so just want enough hitStrength to visibly damage the armor
5953                float hitStrength = member.getHullSpec().getArmorRating() * 2f;
5954                
5955                float hullDamageFraction = 0.025f * damageMult;
5956                float max = 0.5f + random.nextFloat() * 0.1f;
5957                float min = 0.01f + random.nextFloat() * 0.04f;
5958                if (hullDamageFraction > max) hullDamageFraction = max;
5959                if (hullDamageFraction < min) hullDamageFraction = min;
5960                
5961                if (hitStrength > 0) {
5962                        float numHits = 3f;
5963                        for (int i = 0; i < numHits; i++) {
5964                                member.getStatus().applyDamage(hitStrength / numHits, hullDamageFraction / numHits);
5965                        }       
5966                        if (member.getStatus().getHullFraction() < 0.01f) {
5967                                member.getStatus().setHullFraction(0.01f);
5968                        }
5969                        
5970                        boolean isPF = member != null && member.getFleetData() != null &&
5971                                        member.getFleetData().getFleet() != null && member.getFleetData().getFleet().isPlayerFleet();
5972                        
5973                        if (withCRDamage) {
5974                                float crPerDep = member.getDeployCost();
5975                                float currCR = member.getRepairTracker().getBaseCR();
5976                                float crDamage = Math.min(currCR, crPerDep * 0.1f * damageMult);
5977                                if (crDamage > 0) {
5978                                        if (isPF) {
5979                                                member.getRepairTracker().applyCREvent(-crDamage, crDamageId, crDamageReason);
5980                                        } else {
5981                                                member.getRepairTracker().applyCREvent(-crDamage, null, null);
5982                                        }
5983                                }
5984                        }
5985                        
5986                        if (withMessage && isPF) {
5987                                MessageIntel intel = new MessageIntel(messageText,
5988                                                                                Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor());
5989                                intel.setIcon(Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("intel", "damage_report"));
5990                                
5991                                if (textPanel != null) {
5992                                        Global.getSector().getIntelManager().addIntelToTextPanel(intel, textPanel);
5993                                } else {
5994                                        Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().addMessage(intel, MessageClickAction.REFIT_TAB, member);
5995                                }
5996                        }
5997                }
5998        }

6000        public static float getBonusXPForRecovering(FleetMemberAPI member) {
6001                float ownedShip = Global.getSettings().getBonusXP("recoverOwnedShip");
6002                float threshold = Global.getSettings().getBonusXP("recoverNoBonusXPDeploymentPoints");
6003                
6004                if (member.getOwner() == 0) {
6005                        return ownedShip;
6006                }
6007                
6008                float f = 1f - member.getDeploymentPointsCost() / threshold;
6009                if (f < 0) f = 0;
6010                if (f > 1) f = 1;
6011                
6012                return f;
6013        }

6015        public static float [] getBonusXPForScuttling(FleetMemberAPI member) {

6020                        if (member == record.getMember() && record.getMember() != null) {
6021                                points += record.getSPSpent();
6022                                xp += record.getBonusXPFractionGained() * record.getSPSpent();
6023                        }
6024                }

6027                }
6028                return new float[] {0f, 0f};

6066        public static int computeEconUnitChangeFromTradeModChange(CommodityOnMarketAPI com, int quantity) {
6067                float currQty = com.getCombinedTradeModQuantity();
6068                int currMod = (int) com.getModValueForQuantity(currQty);
6069                
6070                float quantityWithTX = com.getTradeMod().getModifiedValue() + quantity + 
6071                                                                Math.max(com.getTradeModPlus().getModifiedValue(), 0) +
6072                                                                Math.min(com.getTradeModMinus().getModifiedValue(), 0);
6073                
6074                int newMod = (int) com.getModValueForQuantity(quantityWithTX);
6075                
6076                int diff = newMod - currMod;
6077                
6078                return diff;
6079        }
6080        
6081        public static void affectAvailabilityWithinReason(CommodityOnMarketAPI com, int quantity) {
6082                int units = computeEconUnitChangeFromTradeModChange(com, quantity);
6083                int maxUnits = Math.min(3, Math.max(com.getMaxDemand(), com.getMaxSupply()));
6084                if (Math.abs(units) > maxUnits) {
6085                        int sign = (int) Math.signum(quantity);
6086                        quantity = (int) Math.round(com.getQuantityForModValue(maxUnits));
6087                        quantity *= sign;
6088                }
6089                com.addTradeMod("mod_" + Misc.genUID(), quantity, BaseSubmarketPlugin.TRADE_IMPACT_DAYS);
6090        }

6195        public static boolean shouldShowDamageFloaty(ShipAPI source, ShipAPI target) {
6196                if (target == null || !Global.getCombatEngine().getShips().contains(target)) {
6197                        return false;
6198                }
6199                CombatEngineAPI engine = Global.getCombatEngine();
6200                ShipAPI playerShip = engine.getPlayerShip();
6201                
6202                boolean sourceIsPlayerShipWing = false;
6203                sourceIsPlayerShipWing = source != null && source.getWing() != null && 
6204                                                                 source.getWing().getSourceShip() == playerShip;
6205                
6206                CombatEntityAPI followedEntity = engine.getCombatUI().getEntityToFollowV2();
6207                boolean showFloaty = target == playerShip || // this is the player's ship
6208                target == followedEntity || // getting video feed from this ship
6209                                                         source == playerShip || // the damage came from the player's ship
6210                                                         sourceIsPlayerShipWing ||
6211                                                         target == playerShip.getShipTarget() || // the ship is the player ship's target
6212                                                         engine.hasAttachedFloaty(target); // the ship already has a floaty on it, meaning the player is likely looking at it
6213                showFloaty = showFloaty && !target.isFighter(); // no floaties on fighters
6214                showFloaty = showFloaty && Global.getSettings().isShowDamageFloaties();
6215                return showFloaty;
6216        }

6274        public static float IMPACT_VOLUME_MULT = Global.getSettings().getFloat("impactSoundVolumeMult");
6275        
6276        public static void playSound(ApplyDamageResultAPI result, Vector2f loc, Vector2f vel,
6277                                                                String lightShields, String solidShields, String heavyShields,
6278                                                                String lightHull, String solidHull, String heavyHull
6279                                                                ) {
6280                float shieldDam = result.getDamageToShields();
6281                float armorDam = result.getTotalDamageToArmor();
6282                float hullDam = result.getDamageToHull();
6283                float fluxDam = result.getEmpDamage();
6284                
6285                
6286                float totalDam = shieldDam + armorDam + hullDam;
6287                // if no damage, don't play sounds
6288                if (totalDam + fluxDam <= 0) return;
6289                
6290                float vol = 1f;
6291                
6292                float volMult = IMPACT_VOLUME_MULT;
6293                
6294                // if shields were damaged, then ONLY shields were damaged
6295                if (shieldDam > 0) {
6296                        String soundId = null;
6297                        if (shieldDam < 70) {
6298                                vol = shieldDam / 20f;
6299                                if (vol > 1) vol = 1;
6300                                soundId = lightShields;
6301                        } else if (shieldDam < 200) {
6302                                soundId = solidShields;
6303                        } else {
6304                                soundId = heavyShields;
6305                        }
6306                        if (soundId != null) {
6307                                Global.getSoundPlayer().playSound(soundId, 1f, vol * volMult, loc, vel);
6308                        }
6309                        return;
6310                }
6311                
6312                String soundId = null;
6313                
6314                float physicalDam = armorDam + hullDam + fluxDam;
6315                //System.out.println(physicalDam);
6316                if (physicalDam < 5) {
6317                        vol = physicalDam / 5f;
6318                        if (vol > 1) vol = 1;
6319                        soundId = lightHull;
6320                } else if (physicalDam < 40) {
6321                        soundId = lightHull;
6322                } else if (physicalDam < 150) {
6323                        soundId = solidHull;
6324                } else {
6325                        soundId = heavyHull;
6326                }
6327
6328                if (soundId != null) {
6329                        Global.getSoundPlayer().playSound(soundId, 1f, vol * volMult, loc, vel);
6330                }
6331                return;
6332        }

6339        public static float getShipWeight(ShipAPI ship, boolean adjustForNonCombat) {
6340                if (ship.isDrone()) return 0.1f;
6341                boolean nonCombat = ship.isNonCombat(false);
6342                float weight = 0;
6343                switch (ship.getHullSize()) {
6344                case CAPITAL_SHIP: weight += 8; break;
6345                case CRUISER: weight += 4; break;
6346                case DESTROYER: weight += 2; break;
6347                case FRIGATE: weight += 1; break;
6348                case FIGHTER: weight += 1; break;
6349                }
6350                if (ship.getHullSpec().isPhase() && (ship.isFrigate() || ship.isDestroyer())) {
6351                        weight += 2f;
6352                }
6353                if (nonCombat && adjustForNonCombat) weight *= 0.25f;
6354                if (ship.isDrone()) weight *= 0.1f;
6355                return weight;
6356        }

6368        public static boolean isAvoidingPlayerHalfheartedly(CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
6369                if (fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_NEVER_AVOID_PLAYER_SLOWLY)) {
6370                        return false;
6371                }
6372                CampaignFleetAPI player = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
6373                boolean avoidingPlayer = fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_AVOID_PLAYER_SLOWLY);
6374                if (avoidingPlayer && !fleet.isHostileTo(player)) return true;
6375                
6376                CampaignFleetAPI fleeingFrom = fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getFleet(FleetAIFlags.NEAREST_FLEEING_FROM);
6377                if (fleeingFrom != null && fleeingFrom.isPlayerFleet()) {
6378                        if (Misc.shouldNotWantRunFromPlayerEvenIfWeaker(fleet) && fleet.isHostileTo(player)) {
6379                                return true;
6380                        }
6381                }
6382                return false;
6383        }

6396        /**
6397         * Probably wrong sometimes...
6398         * @return "a" or "an" for word.
6399         */
6400        public static String getAOrAnFor(String word) {
6401                word = word.toLowerCase();
6402            for (String other : new String[] {"euler", "heir", "honest", "hono"}) {
6403                if (word.startsWith(other)) {
6404                    return "an";
6405                }
6406            }
6407
6408            if (word.startsWith("hour") && !word.startsWith("houri")) {
6409                return "an";
6410            }
6411
6412            Pattern p;
6413            Matcher m;
6414
6415            for (String regex : new String[] { "^e[uw]", "^onc?e\b", "^uni([^nmd]|mo)", "^u[bcfhjkqrst][aeiou]"}) {
6416                p = Pattern.compile("(?is)" + regex + ".*");
6417                    m = p.matcher(word);
6418                    if (m.matches()) {
6419                    return "a";
6420                    }
6421            }
6422
6423            p = Pattern.compile("(?is)" + "^U[NK][AIEO]");
6424            m = p.matcher(word);
6425            if (m.matches()) {
6426                return "a";
6427            }
6428
6429            for (String letter : new String[] { "a", "e", "i", "o", "u" }) {
6430                if (word.startsWith(letter)) {
6431                        return "an";
6432                }
6433            }
6434            
6435            p = Pattern.compile("(?is)" + "^y(b[lor]|cl[ea]|fere|gg|p[ios]|rou|tt)" + ".*");
6436            m = p.matcher(word);
6437            if (m.matches()) {
6438                return "an";
6439            }
6440
6441            return "a";
6442        }

6445        public static void moveToMarket(PersonAPI person, MarketAPI destination, boolean alwaysAddToCommDirectory) {
6446                ContactIntel intel = ContactIntel.getContactIntel(person);
6447                if (intel != null) {
6448                        intel.relocateToMarket(destination, false);
6449                } else {
6450                        boolean addToComms = alwaysAddToCommDirectory;
6451                        boolean hidden = false;
6452                        if (person.getMarket() != null) {
6453                                MarketAPI market = person.getMarket();
6454                                CommDirectoryEntryAPI entry = market.getCommDirectory().getEntryForPerson(person);
6455                                if (entry != null) {
6456                                        addToComms = true;
6457                                        hidden = entry.isHidden();
6458                                }
6459                                market.removePerson(person);
6460                                market.getCommDirectory().removePerson(person);
6461                        }
6462                        
6463                        if (!destination.getPeopleCopy().contains(person)) {
6464                                destination.addPerson(person);
6465                        }
6466                        person.setMarket(destination);
6467                        
6468                        if (addToComms) {
6469                                if (destination.getCommDirectory() != null && 
6470                                                destination.getCommDirectory().getEntryForPerson(person) == null) {
6471                                        destination.getCommDirectory().addPerson(person);
6472                                        if (hidden) {
6473                                                CommDirectoryEntryAPI entry = destination.getCommDirectory().getEntryForPerson(person);
6474                                                if (entry != null) {
6475                                                        entry.setHidden(true);
6476                                                }
6477                                        }
6478                                }
6479                        }
6480                }
6481        }

6509        /**
6510         * Whether it prevents salvage, surveying, etc. But NOT things that require only being
6511         * seen to ruin them, such as SpySat deployments.
6512         * @param fleet
6513         * @return
6514         */
6515        public static boolean isInsignificant(CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
6516                boolean recentlyBeaten = fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_RECENTLY_DEFEATED_BY_PLAYER);
6517                if (recentlyBeaten) return true;
6518                
6519                CampaignFleetAPI pf = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
6520                if (pf == null) return true; // ??
6521                if (fleet.getAI() != null) {
6522                        EncounterOption opt = fleet.getAI().pickEncounterOption(null, pf);
6523                        if (opt == EncounterOption.DISENGAGE || opt == EncounterOption.HOLD_VS_STRONGER) {
6524                                return true;
6525                        }
6526                        if (opt == EncounterOption.ENGAGE) {
6527                                return false;
6528                        }
6529                }
6530                int pfCount = pf.getFleetSizeCount();
6531                int otherCount = fleet.getFleetSizeCount();
6532                
6533                return otherCount <= pfCount / 4;
6534        }
6535        
6536        /**
6537         * Mainly for avoiding stuff like "pirate fleet with 4 rustbuckets will run away from the player's
6538         * 4 regular-quality frigates". Fleets that this evaluates to true for will avoid the player slowly.
6539         * @param fleet
6540         * @return
6541         */
6542        public static boolean shouldNotWantRunFromPlayerEvenIfWeaker(CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
6543                boolean recentlyBeaten = fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_RECENTLY_DEFEATED_BY_PLAYER);
6544                if (recentlyBeaten) return true;
6545                if (fleet.getFleetData() == null) return false;
6546                
6547                float count = 0;
6548                for (FleetMemberAPI member : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
6549                        if (!member.isCivilian() && member.getHullSpec() != null) {
6550                                switch (member.getHullSpec().getHullSize()) {
6551                                case CAPITAL_SHIP: count += 4; break;
6552                                case CRUISER: count += 3; break;
6553                                case DESTROYER: count += 2; break;
6554                                case FRIGATE: count += 1; break;
6555                                }
6556                        }
6557                }
6558                
6559                CampaignFleetAPI pf = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
6560                float pfCount = 0;
6561                for (FleetMemberAPI member : pf.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
6562                        if (!member.isCivilian() && member.getHullSpec() != null) {
6563                                switch (member.getHullSpec().getHullSize()) {
6564                                case CAPITAL_SHIP: pfCount += 4; break;
6565                                case CRUISER: pfCount += 3; break;
6566                                case DESTROYER: pfCount += 2; break;
6567                                case FRIGATE: pfCount += 1; break;
6568                                }
6569                        }
6570                }
6571                
6572                if (count > pfCount * 0.67f) {
6573                        return true;
6574                }
6575                
6576                if (isInsignificant(fleet) && count <= 6) return true;
6577                
6578                return false;
6579        }

6581        public static float findKth(float[] arr, int k) {
6582                if (arr == null || arr.length <= k || k < 0) {
6583                        return -1;
6584                }
6585
6586                int from = 0;
6587                int to = arr.length - 1;
6588
6589                while (from < to) {
6590                        int r = from;
6591                        int w = to;
6592                        float mid = arr[(r + w) / 2];
6593
6594                        while (r < w) {
6595                                if (arr[r] >= mid) {
6596                                        float tmp = arr[w];
6597                                        arr[w] = arr[r];
6598                                        arr[r] = tmp;
6599                                        w--;
6600                                } else {
6601                                        r++;
6602                                }
6603                        }
6604
6605                        if (arr[r] > mid) r--;
6606
6607                        if (k <= r) {
6608                                to = r;
6609                        } else {
6610                                from = r + 1;
6611                        }
6612                }
6613
6614                return arr[k];
6615        }

6626        public static Vector2f bezier(Vector2f p0, Vector2f p1, Vector2f p2, float t) {
6627                if (t < 0) t = 0;
6628                if (t > 1) t = 1;
6629                Vector2f r = new Vector2f();
6630                r.x = (1f - t) * (1f - t) * p0.x + 2f * (1f - t) * t * p1.x + t * t * p2.x;
6631                r.y = (1f - t) * (1f - t) * p0.y + 2f * (1f - t) * t * p1.y + t * t * p2.y;
6632                return r;
6633        }
6634        
6635        public static Vector2f bezierCubic(Vector2f p0, Vector2f p1, Vector2f p2, Vector2f p3, float t) {
6636                if (t < 0) t = 0;
6637                if (t > 1) t = 1;
6638                Vector2f r = new Vector2f();
6639                
6640                r.x = (1f - t) * (1f - t) * (1f -t) * p0.x + 
6641                                3f * (1f - t) * (1f - t) * t * p1.x +
6642                                3f * (1f - t) * t * t * p2.x +
6643                                t * t * t * p3.x;
6644                r.y = (1f - t) * (1f - t) * (1f -t) * p0.y + 
6645                                3f * (1f - t) * (1f - t) * t * p1.y +
6646                                3f * (1f - t) * t * t * p2.y +
6647                                t * t * t * p3.y;
6648                return r;
6649        }

6685        public static boolean crossesAnySlipstream(LocationAPI location, Vector2f from, Vector2f to) {
6686                for (CampaignTerrainAPI ter : location.getTerrainCopy()) {
6687                        if (ter.getPlugin() instanceof SlipstreamTerrainPlugin2) {
6688                                SlipstreamTerrainPlugin2 plugin = (SlipstreamTerrainPlugin2) ter.getPlugin();
6689                                List<SlipstreamSegment> segments = plugin.getSegments();
6690                                int skip = Math.max(20, segments.size() / 10);
6691                                for (int i = 0; i < segments.size(); i += skip) {
6692                                        int i2 = i + skip;
6693                                        if (i2 > segments.size() - skip/2) i2 = segments.size() - 1;
6694                                        if (i2 >= segments.size()) i2 = segments.size() - 1;
6695                                        
6696                                        if (i2 <= i) break;
6697                                        
6698                                        Vector2f p = intersectSegments(segments.get(i).loc, segments.get(i2).loc, from, to);
6699                                        if (p != null) return true;
6700                                }
6701                        }
6702                }
6703                return false;
6704        }

6706        public static void computeCoreWorldsExtent() {
6707                Vector2f min = new Vector2f();
6708                Vector2f max = new Vector2f();
6709                for (StarSystemAPI curr : Global.getSector().getStarSystems()) {
6710                        if (curr.hasTag(Tags.THEME_CORE)) {
6711                                Vector2f loc = curr.getLocation();
6712                                min.x = Math.min(min.x, loc.x);
6713                                min.y = Math.min(min.y, loc.y);
6714                                max.x = Math.max(max.x, loc.x);
6715                                max.y = Math.max(max.y, loc.y);
6716                        }
6717                }
6718                
6719                Vector2f core = Vector2f.add(min, max, new Vector2f());
6720                core.scale(0.5f);
6721                
6722                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$coreWorldsMin", min);
6723                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$coreWorldsMax", max);
6724                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$coreWorldsCenter", core);
6725        }

6791                return turnTowardsFacingV2(missile, desiredFacing, angVel);

6794        public static boolean turnTowardsFacingV2(MissileAPI missile, float desiredFacing, float relativeAngVel) {              
6795                
6796                float turnVel = missile.getAngularVelocity() - relativeAngVel;
6797                float absTurnVel = Math.abs(turnVel);
6798                
6799                float turnDecel = missile.getEngineController().getTurnDeceleration();
6800                // v t - 0.5 a t t = dist
6801                // dv = a t;  t = v / a
6802                float decelTime = absTurnVel / turnDecel; 
6803                float decelDistance = absTurnVel * decelTime - 0.5f * turnDecel * decelTime * decelTime;
6804                
6805                float facingAfterNaturalDecel = missile.getFacing() + Math.signum(turnVel) * decelDistance;
6806                float diffWithEventualFacing = getAngleDiff(facingAfterNaturalDecel, desiredFacing);
6807                float diffWithCurrFacing = getAngleDiff(missile.getFacing(), desiredFacing);
6808                
6809                if (diffWithEventualFacing > 1f) {
6810                        float turnDir = getClosestTurnDirection(missile.getFacing(), desiredFacing);
6811                        if (Math.signum(turnVel) == Math.signum(turnDir)) {
6812                                if (decelDistance > diffWithCurrFacing) {
6813                                        turnDir = -turnDir;
6814                                }
6815                        }
6816                        if (turnDir < 0) {
6817                                missile.giveCommand(ShipCommand.TURN_RIGHT);
6818                        } else if (turnDir >= 0) {
6819                                missile.giveCommand(ShipCommand.TURN_LEFT);
6820                        } else {
6821                                return false;
6822                        }
6823                }
6824                return false;
6825        }

6919        public static float getColorDist(Color one, Color two) {
6920                float r = Math.abs(one.getRed() - two.getRed());
6921                float g = Math.abs(one.getGreen() - two.getGreen());
6922                float b = Math.abs(one.getBlue() - two.getBlue());
6923                float a = Math.abs(one.getAlpha() - two.getAlpha());
6924                
6925                return (float) Math.sqrt(r * r + g * g + b * b + a * a);
6926        }

6940        public static float getFringeFactor(Vector2f loc) {
6941                float sw = Global.getSettings().getFloat("sectorWidth");
6942                float sh = Global.getSettings().getFloat("sectorHeight");
6943                float mult = 0.8f;
6944                //float mult = 1f;
6945                float a = sw * 0.5f * mult;
6946                float b = sh * 0.5f * mult;
6947                float x = loc.x;
6948                float y = loc.y;
6949                
6950                float f = (x * x) / (a * a) + (y * y)/ (b * b);
6951                if (f < 0) f = 0;
6952                if (f > 1) f = 1;
6953                return f;
6954        }

6985        public static String genEntityCatalogId(String firstChar, int cycleOverride, int monthOverride, int dayOverride, CatalogEntryType type) {
6986                
6987                String base = "Perseus";
6988                
6989                int cycle = Global.getSector().getClock().getCycle();
6990                cycle += 3000;
6991                if (cycleOverride > 0) cycle = cycleOverride; 
6992                
6993                int month = Global.getSector().getClock().getMonth();
6994                if (monthOverride > 0) month = monthOverride;
6995                int day = Global.getSector().getClock().getDay();
6996                if (dayOverride > 0) day = dayOverride;
6997                
6998                String s1 = Integer.toHexString(cycle).toUpperCase();
6999                
7000                Random r = StarSystemGenerator.random;
7001                
7002                String s0 = Integer.toHexString(r.nextInt(16)).toUpperCase();
7003                if (firstChar != null) s0 = firstChar;
7004                
7005                String s2 = Integer.toHexString(month).toUpperCase();
7006                String s3 = Integer.toHexString(day).toUpperCase();
7007                
7008//              s1 = "" + cycle;
7009//              s0 = "";
7010                
7011                while (s1.length() < 3) s1 = "0" + s1;
7012                while (s3.length() < 2) s3 = "0" + s3;
7013                
7014                return base + " " + s0 + s1 + "-" + s2 + s3 + type.suffix;
7015        }

7063        public static float countEnemyWeightInArcAroundLocation(ShipAPI ship, Vector2f loc, float dir, float arc, float maxRange,
7064                                                                ShipAPI ignore, boolean ignoreFightersAndModules) {
7065                return countEnemyWeightInArcAroundLocation(ship.getOwner(), loc, dir, arc, maxRange, ignore, ignoreFightersAndModules, false);
7066        }
7067        public static float countEnemyWeightInArcAroundLocation(int owner, Vector2f loc, 
7068                                float dir, float arc, float maxRange,
7069                                ShipAPI ignore, boolean ignoreFightersAndModules, boolean awareOnly) {
7070                CombatEngineAPI engine = Global.getCombatEngine();
7071                List<ShipAPI> ships = engine.getAllShips();
7072                
7073                float weight = 0;
7074                for (ShipAPI other : ships) {
7075                        if (ignoreFightersAndModules) {
7076                                if (other.isFighter()) continue;
7077                                if (other.isStationModule()) continue;
7078                        }
7079                        if (other.isFighter() && other.getWing() != null && !other.getWing().isLeader(other)) continue;
7080                        if (other.isHulk()) continue;
7081                        if (other.isDrone()) continue;
7082                        if (other.isShuttlePod()) continue;
7083                        if (other.getOwner() == 100) continue;
7084                        if (owner == other.getOwner()) continue;
7085                        //if (other.isRetreating()) continue;
7086                        if (other.controlsLocked()) continue;
7087                        if (other == ignore) continue;
7088                        if (awareOnly && !engine.isAwareOf(owner, other)) continue;
7089                        
7090                        float dist = getDistance(loc, other.getLocation());
7091                        if (dist > maxRange) continue;
7092
7093                        if (arc >= 360f || isInArc(dir, arc, loc, other.getLocation())) {
7094                                weight += getShipWeight(other);
7095                                //weight += other.getHullSize().ordinal();
7096                        }
7097                }
7098                return weight;
7099        }

7124        public static SpriteAPI getWeaponSkin(ShipAPI ship, String weaponId, WeaponSkinType type) {
7125                String cat = null;
7126                SpriteAPI skin = null;
7127                if (ship.getOwner() == 0 || ship.getOriginalOwner() == 0) {
7128                        cat = "weaponSkinsPlayerOnly";
7129                        skin = getWeaponSkin(cat, weaponId, ship, type);
7130                }
7131                if (skin != null) return skin;
7132                
7133                cat = "weaponSkinsPlayerAndNPC";
7134                skin = getWeaponSkin(cat, weaponId, ship, type);
7135                return skin;
7136        }
