7139        public static SpriteAPI getWeaponSkin(String cat, String weaponId, ShipAPI ship, WeaponSkinType type) {
7140                
7141                String exclude = "weaponSkinsExcludeFromSharing";
7142                String style = ship.getHullStyleId();
7143                
7144                List<String> skins = Global.getSettings().getSpriteKeys(cat);
7145                Set<String> noSharing = new LinkedHashSet<String>(Global.getSettings().getSpriteKeys(exclude));
7146                
7147                List<SpriteAPI> matching = new ArrayList<SpriteAPI>();
7148                String keyForHull = weaponId + ":" + style + ":" + type.name();
7149                for (String key : skins) {
7150                        if (key.equals(keyForHull)) {
7151                                return Global.getSettings().getSprite(cat, key);
7152                        }
7153                        if (key.startsWith(weaponId) && key.endsWith(type.name()) && !noSharing.contains(key)) {
7154                                matching.add(Global.getSettings().getSprite(cat, key));
7155                        }
7156                }
7157                
7158                if (!matching.isEmpty()) {
7159                        SpriteAPI best = null;
7160                        float minDist = Float.MAX_VALUE;
7161                        
7162                        for (SpriteAPI curr : matching) {
7163                                float dist = Misc.getColorDist(ship.getSpriteAPI().getAverageBrightColor(), curr.getAverageBrightColor());
7164                                if (dist < minDist) {
7165                                        best = curr;
7166                                        minDist = dist;
7167                                }
7168                        }
7169                        return best;
7170                }
7171                return null;
7172        }

7194        public static int computeFleetMemberCrewSalary(FleetMemberAPI member, boolean withCrewFraction) {
7195                if (member.getMinCrew() <= 0) return 0;
7196                float salMult = member.getStats().getDynamic().getStat(Stats.SHIP_CREW_SALARY_MULT).getModifiedValue();
7197                if (Misc.isExtended()) salMult *= Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_crewSalaryMult");
7198                
7199                float baseCrew = member.getHullSpec().getMinCrew();
7200                float crewReq = member.getStats().getMinCrewMod().computeEffective(baseCrew);
7201                salMult *= Math.min(5f, crewReq / Math.max(1f, baseCrew));
7202                
7203                if (withCrewFraction) {
7204                        float f = member.getCrewFraction();
7205                        salMult *= f;
7206                }
7207                
7208                int salary = Math.round(member.getHullSpec().getCrewSalaryPerMonth() * salMult);
7209                return salary;
7210        }
7211        
7212        /**
7213         * JUST crew, not marines.
7214         * @return
7215         */
7216        public static int computeTotalCrewSalaryForPlayerFleet() {
7217                CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
7218                int crewSalary = Global.getSettings().getInt("crewSalary");
7219                if (Misc.isExtended()) {
7220                        crewSalary *= Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_crewSalaryMult");
7221                        crewSalary = (int) crewSalary;
7222                }
7223                
7224                int totalSalary = 0;
7225                int totalCrew = playerFleet.getCargo().getCrew();
7226                int alreadyPaidCrew = 0;
7227                
7228                for (FleetMemberAPI member : playerFleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
7229                        int crew = (int) Math.min(member.getMinCrew(), member.getCrewComposition().getCrewInt());
7230                        if (crew <= 0) continue;
7231                        int currSalary = computeFleetMemberCrewSalary(member, true);
7232                        alreadyPaidCrew += crew;
7233                        totalSalary += currSalary;
7234                }
7235                
7236                totalSalary += Math.max(0, totalCrew - alreadyPaidCrew) * crewSalary;
7237                
7238                return totalSalary;
7239        }

7243        public static boolean isSpacerShareEnabled() {
7244                if (!isExtended() && Global.getSettings().getBoolean("spacerShareEnabledExtModeOnly")) {
7245                        return false;
7246                }
7247                if (!isSpacerStart() && Global.getSettings().getBoolean("spacerShareEnabledSpacerModeOnly")) {
7248                        return false;
7249                }
7250                return Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_spacerSharePerMonth") > 0;
7251        }
7252        public static int computeSpacerShareThreshold() {
7253                CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
7254                int marineSalary = Global.getSettings().getInt("marineSalary");
7255                if (Misc.isExtended()) {
7256                        marineSalary *= Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_marineSalaryMult");
7257                        marineSalary = (int) marineSalary;
7258                }
7259                int crewCost = Misc.computeTotalCrewSalaryForPlayerFleet();
7260                int marineCost = playerFleet.getCargo().getMarines() * marineSalary;
7261
7262                
7263                int totalSalary = crewCost + marineCost; 
7264                
7265                for (OfficerDataAPI od : playerFleet.getFleetData().getOfficersCopy()) {
7266                        float salary = Misc.getOfficerSalary(od.getPerson(), true);
7267                        totalSalary += (int)Math.round(salary);
7268                }
7269                
7270                float thresholdMonths = Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_spacerShareThresholdSalaryMonths");
7271                return (int)Math.round(totalSalary * thresholdMonths);
7272        }

7275        public static int getModifiedMissionReward(SectorEntityToken target, int reward) {
7276                if (target == null) return reward;
7277                //if (!Misc.isExtended()) return reward;
7278                
7279                float dist = 0f;
7280                StarSystemAPI askonia = Global.getSector().getStarSystem("askonia");
7281                if(askonia != null) {
7282                        dist = Misc.getDistanceLY(target.getLocationInHyperspace(), askonia.getLocation());
7283                } else {
7284                        dist = Misc.getDistanceLY(target.getLocationInHyperspace(), new Vector2f());
7285                }
7286                
7287                String prefix = "";
7288                if (Misc.isExtended()) prefix = "ext_";
7289                
7290                float min = Global.getSettings().getFloat(prefix + "missionRewardMinDist");
7291                float max = Global.getSettings().getFloat(prefix + "missionRewardMaxDist");
7292                float bonus = Global.getSettings().getFloat(prefix + "missionRewardMaxBonusFraction");
7293                float cap = Global.getSettings().getFloat(prefix + "missionRewardBonusCap");
7294                
7295                if (dist < min) return reward;
7296                
7297                if (dist > max) dist = max;
7298                
7299                float bonusMult = bonus * (dist - min) / (max - min);
7300
7301                int bonusCredits = (int) Math.min(cap, bonusMult * reward);
7302                return BaseHubMission.getRoundNumber(reward + bonusCredits);
7303        }
